programme.title: 地球深度行V 大地的宝藏
programme.desc: 摄制队走访美国﹑英国﹑ 瑞士﹑澳洲﹑土耳其﹑以色列﹑埃及﹑中国及亚洲等国家,访寻学者专家多年来从大地发掘的宝藏及科研成果,当中包括高山上经历大洪水形成的奇异化石;全球首卷手抄丝绸中文圣经;以色列铸造挪亚方舟金币场等。n一切一切的资料,让观众在欣赏地球的创造同时,见证上帝的奇妙创作及精密设计,从心感受祂对我们的恩典及爱护,同时亦透过昔日方舟洪水及今日全球暖化问题的共同处,启示人类身为地球管理者,应该好好珍惜及保护地球的责任,改变世界,从你开始。

高朋满座#31粤
programme.desc: 有义和有情常常争吃东西，一个旧喼内藏很多高家极有收藏价值的旧衣，见证高家的温情，但六婆揭发有义用不同的方法将该条旧裤抛弃。有义使计让有朋等三人穿上由他准备的「回礼」，但三人的鬼祟令警察误会三人是贼人。

programme.title: 天龙八部#4粤普
programme.desc: 乔峰得知汪剑通病重，于是赶回丐帮，汪剑通临终前要爱徒谨记心念家国天下；段誉和婉清回到大理，此时岳老三出现，段誉决定以武定输赢；段誉为婉清设宴，婉清无意间看到王妃手上的红印，才知道对方是师父要杀的仇人…

programme.title: 交易现场粤 及 信辉康养特约︰湾区安老Chill凡体验粤
阿爷厨房粤
programme.desc: 压轴一集继续带来意头美食，感受贺年滋味。鼎爷蒸鱼有秘技，以胡椒粒垫底，隔筛淋上蒜蓉韭菜油，炮制「韭香蒸东星」。他又选用各具风味的素菜食材，煮出寓意十全十美的「十样菜」。但多种菜蔬的耐火程度不一，烹调时有甚么窍门？「煎堆碌碌，金银满屋」，鼎爷及后示范的「黄金煎堆」，从外皮至红豆蓉馅料皆要亲手制作，成品倍添温暖窝心。竹笋亦有「期间限定」，如何品尝春笋、冬笋、沙梨笋最合适？此外，主持们还会介绍多款瓜子。

programme.title: 流行都市粤
programme.desc: 重症肌无力症是种自体免疫疾病，会影响正常肌肉收缩功能，医生如何以血液检查作诊断？病情如严重可引致呼吸及吞食困难，长远损害身体机能，怎样治疗为佳？前列腺癌于男性常见癌症排第三，泌尿外科医生指其症状与前列腺肥大相似，宜藉检查分清病症。医生亦会为前列腺癌患者度身订造治疗方法，个中包括美容界采用的HIFU，医疗效果甚为理想，却非所有病人合适？这集「睇𩠌食饭」，由李文星师傅示范贺年菜「金钱金蚝红烧肉」。

programme.title: 身体最诚实粤

programme.title: Hands Up粤

programme.title: 非常检控观#13粤PG
programme.desc: 伍家俊被指与公孙珀合谋作弊，向希仁等道出他与舒琴、彦枫的瓜葛。希仁与颂星以实习课为名，安排学生到律政中心上模拟法庭，彦枫、舒琴分别担任控方与被告，骆子豪担任辩方，希仁以小禹的案情试探各人反应。小禹转院后情况好转，真凶得知后有所行动……公孙珀等现身执业试咨询会，当众与律师会主席对质！湘言穿著网红凌卓霓售卖的蝴蝶花裙上班，并与熊飞等谈及卓霓，熊飞表现有点反常。熊飞看到卓霓直播时暗示遭家暴，神态激动……

programme.title: 欢乐茶饭#5粤普

programme.title: 聚大金凤呈献:在家宴客60道菜粤
programme.desc: 肥妈施展新煮意，用虾胶酿入虾身，加春卷皮碎油炸两次，细虾「升呢」凤尾大虾？香脆胀卜卜口感，零舍满足！姜有助驱寒暖胃，德哥用姜米炒焗饭，追加腊肉、腊肠、银鱼仔提升香味层次，为观众「送暖」。大宴亲朋必备靓汤，鼎爷以黑蒜、虫草花、鲜鸡煲汤，并教嘉欣自制猪肉虾云吞，滋补又美味！用干螺头煲汤比鲜螺头更甘甜？「鬼马牛肉」是经典粤菜，配上和肉、金不换变奏甚么新滋味？帜哥忆述菜式背后意义，并将独门秘方传授嘉欣。

programme.title: 阿爷厨房粤

programme.title: 流行都市粤
programme.desc: 坏胆固醇过高，会增加心血管疾病及中风的风险。除了不良饮食与缺乏运动，遗传亦是重要成因，心脏科医生提及的家族性高胆固醇血症便是其一。医生指高胆固醇的症状或会在四肢、眼皮等显现，也详述药物治疗方法。「香港义工奖」旨在表扬杰出义工，并鼓励大众积极帮助有需要人士。应届得奖义工畅谈获奖感受，还难忘协助非华语学生融入社会；主办当局代表则分享推动义务工作的点滴。「睇𩠌食饭」，傅季馨示范「脆炸生蚝伴法式番茄酱」。

programme.title: 身体最诚实粤
programme.desc: 了解基因有助透视身体状况，找到难以察觉的病症。从孕妇血液能验出胎儿可有患上唐氏综合症，港产科学家卢煜明细说个中原理，提到该技术还可应用至早期鼻咽癌筛查。卢教授不断突破，藉科研引领癌症检测新方向。预防大肠癌要做筛查，除了当局的筛查计划，坊间也有非入侵式检测，详情如何？手术发展日新月异，新型机械臂可精准应用于微创手术，实际上怎样操作？脚底长期出现刺痛，或与足底筋膜炎有关，专家带来简单测试与舒缓方法。

programme.title: 单恋双城#5粤

programme.desc: 懿芳官司获胜。卓万向心兰、小由道歉。卓万向懿芳说对不起，懿芳亦向他说出心底话。卓万陪心兰看日落，心兰满足离世。小由向妹妹说，决定与她离开。木水跪求小由宽恕。子君致丧时发现启烨，得她启发，启烨向父认错。

programme.title: 名媛望族#40粤PG
programme.desc: (大结局)木水胁持小由，要求她一起离开，启燊救小由时木水紧追，向二人开枪。众见子君有身孕，追问父亲是谁。子君邀卓万往上海开工厂，卓万拒绝。有男孩拿盒子给子君，当中全是卓万成功争取婚姻法案通过的剪报。

programme.title: 东张西望粤
programme.desc: 《东张西望》星期一至日，紧贴追踪社会大事、趣闻逸事，并报道娱乐圈最新动态、艺人消息，以及剧集宣传和花絮。「今日突发」环节为大家追踪即日热门新闻；专题环节，深入探讨大众关心的时事、社会及民生问题，并访问相关的专家。

programme.title: 流行都市粤
programme.desc: 头痛只是症状，而偏头痛是一种脑神经疾病，而且持续、有规律，可严重影响日常生活。脑神经专科医生谈到诊断之法，宜写下「头痛日记」；长期使用抑制剂作治疗，有甚么副作用？年届七旬的周碧玉多次参加健身比赛，还获得不少奖项，但原来她于五十多岁才开始锻练身体，继而考牌成为运动教练？做运动除了让她重拾健康，也增进了与家人的关系！过年要有糕点， Annie师傅在「睇𩠌食饭」示范「啖啖芋头糕」，做法简易。

programme.title: 身体最诚实粤
programme.desc: 面色红润我钟意，但面黄有可能是肝有事？体重正常也有机会患脂肪肝，原来肠道微生态亦会影响肝脏运作？肝脏是身体内最有「重量」的内脏，肝酵素低亦不代表安全。不过，肝科专家陈力元指出，并非人人有脂肪肝都需要接受医治。此外，肝癌一于于中后期才出现病征，陈教授建议定期接受筛查。这集亦了解「先缩后除」的肝癌治疗新方案，较传统的介入式治疗有何优点？职业司机常出现腰背痛，注册脊医特此带来腰椎的小测试动作和舒缓运动。

programme.title: 单恋双城#6粤
programme.desc: 云锋的表弟阿川获调任屯门分行经理，同事们替式适不值。展博请求式适原谅，式适把订婚戒指归还。式适致电刘音，对方作实聘请她。式适首天上班，房务部经理Fanny却不合作。式适劝Elaine不要被恭梓欺骗。

programme.title: 高朋满座#33粤
programme.desc: 有朋于厨艺颁奖礼感言中向悦满高呼「我爱你」，高庆在快餐店玩急口令，多次出现「我爱你」字眼，妙喜忍受不了，要高庆搬到有朋家住。高庆本欲向妙喜说「我爱你」，但突然失声，妙喜以为他「装聋扮哑」。

programme.title: 天龙八部#6粤普PG
programme.desc: 玄悲大师与马大元皆死于自己的绝学之下，众人推测是慕容复所为。段誉身中邪毒，段正明带他到天龙寺求助，怎料遇上大轮明王前来夺取六脉神剑剑谱，大师们联手也无法将他击退，情急之下，段誉唯有自观自学六脉神剑…

programme.desc: 关于友谊、成长，关于正义战胜邪恶的故事。高中生麦斯的父亲意外死亡，他搬回老家，找寻父亲的过去，却意外获得超能力与一个飞行机器人，经由训练后麦斯逐渐掌握这股力量，穿上盔甲发挥潜在力量变成钢铁战士，以对抗威胁世界的神秘力量。

programme.title: 妈妈要出嫁
programme.desc: 【任劳任怨大半辈子的慈母觉醒切割贪财不孝子】因丈夫早逝，独自抚养四名子女的尹正爱，就如同天下所有的妈妈一样，为了孩子总是愿意牺牲自己，一路从路边的菜贩打拼，多年后与大女儿允姬开了间点心餐厅。正当一切都看似幸福美满时，孩子们的婚姻、事业、学业纷纷出现状况，在面对问题时儿女们总持相反意见，并只贪图母亲的遗产，让正爱深感背叛，在朋友的劝说下，正爱打算不再以孩子为生活重心，并在缘分安排下开始了第二春。

programme.title: 女王之家
programme.desc: 【心机渣男出轨妻子闺蜜为夺下豪门不择手段！】人人称羡的模范夫妻申明燮与韩善珠，在纪念婚礼当天揭开了幸福假象。出身豪门的善珠外表完美，内心却藏著被背叛的恐惧；出身贫寒的明燮，靠婚姻翻转人生却陷入外遇泥沼。而第三者尹美罗，不仅成为他的灵魂寄托，更在命运的捉弄下与善珠结为好友。当真相逐步揭开，爱与恨、正宫与小三的界线逐渐模糊，一场婚礼，也预告了一场悲剧的开始。

programme.title: 韩国小姐
programme.desc: 【2023百想最佳男主角李圣旻社区大叔们联手打造韩国小姐】高中时自恃美貌过人，而没有好好念书的吴智英，毕业后凭借外表当上百货的电梯小姐，看似光鲜亮丽的工作，背后隐藏著许多辛酸，面对毛手毛脚的变态上司，以及百货种种不合理的工作规定，年纪增长且缺乏竞争力另吴智英后悔莫及，偶然的机会下，与现职化妆品公司社长的前男友相遇，公司即将倒闭的金亨俊，与债主郑先生一同把平凡女孩打造为顶级韩国小姐的励志故事。

programme.title: 只属于我的你
programme.desc: 【渣男律师劈腿富豪千金李敏英逆袭成知名设计师】恩静与律师姜胜宰结婚后，原以为会享受奢华生活，但现实却是在婆家被当成佣人使唤。婆婆因恩静没有家世而感到丢脸，胜宰也渐渐冷淡，甚至不愿承认老婆。事实上，恩静发现胜宰根本没有办理结婚登记，当她为了帮助妹妹处理财务问题，办理贷款时才揭露了这个真相。不久后她发现老公与BJ集团继承人有染，决心离开伤心地，重返职场成为知名设计师。与此同时，昔日男友俊夏重新进入她的生活，默默支持她，希望能给她真正的幸福。

programme.title: 奔跑吧蔷薇
programme.desc: 【纨裤子弟情留落难千金，寻觅守护爱情的甜蜜配方】过著丰食无缺没有大小姐架子的蔷薇。一场家中巨变，面临相亲结婚丈夫的背叛，经济困境及失去原生家庭的后盾。困境中凭著对料理的热情及新生活，与食品公司会长的孙子相恋，奔向对方的路上还会遇上什么样的考验?

programme.title: 金装律师
programme.desc: 【改编人气美国影集，张东健×朴炯植联手成为法律界黄金拍档！！】头脑聪明，拥有过目不忘天才能力的高延宇，却因家境关系却步成为律师。混进了律师事务所遇上韩国顶级资深律师崔江锡。随著事件发生与时间相处成为黄金拍档，崔江锡要如何亦师亦友的带著没有正式念过大学也只是菜鸟律师的高延宇打出一片天下呢？

programme.title: 依法相爱吧
programme.desc: 【李升基×李世荣二次合作，青梅竹马谱出律政罗曼史！！】改编自人气网路小说，「怪物天才检察官」金正浩与「韩国小姐出身律师」金琉璃，青梅竹马重逢后，一起经营「LawCafé」的故事。既是律师事务所、又是咖啡馆的小天地里，用温暖的饮品与犀利的法律智慧，帮助无数人伸张正义。从法庭到日常，辩论化为斗嘴，正义化为浪漫，疗愈又甜蜜的爱情由此展开。

programme.title: 好好生活(完)
programme.desc: 【霸道总裁《飞狐外传》林雨申恋上俏邻居《光芒》蔡文静！】吴忧因车祸意外放男友鸽子惨遭分手，而同样在这场车祸中丧命的是雅曼生物科技总裁何西亚的未婚妻陆芸。吴忧分手后寄情于工作，投入新职场认识了陆芸的妹妹陆蔓，成为了闺蜜。在公事上与何西亚有了合作，不打不相识的这对欢喜冤家，好不容易发展成为恋人,此时发现陆芸在他们之间串连起来的缘分…

programme.title: 金装律师
programme.desc: 【改编人气美国影集，张东健×朴炯植联手成为法律界黄金拍档！！】头脑聪明，拥有过目不忘天才能力的高延宇，却因家境关系却步成为律师。混进了律师事务所遇上韩国顶级资深律师崔江锡。随著事件发生与时间相处成为黄金拍档，崔江锡要如何亦师亦友的带著没有正式念过大学也只是菜鸟律师的高延宇打出一片天下呢？

programme.title: 步步惊心
programme.desc: 那一天，张晓的命运被一场车祸彻底改写。她眼看著那辆失控的卡车将自己的灵魂撞出了躯体，而她，既没有进医院也没有进天堂，却是被撞进了清朝的宫廷中。就像铺天盖地的穿越小说里写的那样，张晓的灵魂跨过时间的隧道，在一个叫马尔泰.若曦的十六岁清朝女孩的体内，重生了…时年，康熙第四十三。天下太平，但一场震动历史的「九龙夺嫡」正在暗潮涌动。权利的厮杀，爱情的灼烧，在被无限放大的历史舞台上，张晓，不，是马尔泰•若曦的命运无可避免的与众位亲王阿哥们交织在一起…她知道自己不该卷入这场九王夺嫡的争斗中，可心不由己，因为这里有她所爱的，也有爱著她的…若曦最后选择的究竟是温润如玉的八阿哥，还是面冷心热的四阿哥，又或是出人意料的其他人?等历史的风云过后，可以陪她看夕阳西下、云卷云舒的又将是谁？

programme.desc: 【李升基×李世荣二次合作，青梅竹马谱出律政罗曼史！！】改编自人气网路小说，「怪物天才检察官」金正浩与「韩国小姐出身律师」金琉璃，青梅竹马重逢后，一起经营「LawCafé」的故事。既是律师事务所、又是咖啡馆的小天地里，用温暖的饮品与犀利的法律智慧，帮助无数人伸张正义。从法庭到日常，辩论化为斗嘴，正义化为浪漫，疗愈又甜蜜的爱情由此展开。

programme.desc: 【李升基×李世荣二次合作，青梅竹马谱出律政罗曼史！！】改编自人气网路小说，「怪物天才检察官」金正浩与「韩国小姐出身律师」金琉璃，青梅竹马重逢后，一起经营「LawCafé」的故事。既是律师事务所、又是咖啡馆的小天地里，用温暖的饮品与犀利的法律智慧，帮助无数人伸张正义。从法庭到日常，辩论化为斗嘴，正义化为浪漫，疗愈又甜蜜的爱情由此展开。

programme.title: 妈妈要出嫁
programme.desc: 【任劳任怨大半辈子的慈母觉醒切割贪财不孝子】因丈夫早逝，独自抚养四名子女的尹正爱，就如同天下所有的妈妈一样，为了孩子总是愿意牺牲自己，一路从路边的菜贩打拼，多年后与大女儿允姬开了间点心餐厅。正当一切都看似幸福美满时，孩子们的婚姻、事业、学业纷纷出现状况，在面对问题时儿女们总持相反意见，并只贪图母亲的遗产，让正爱深感背叛，在朋友的劝说下，正爱打算不再以孩子为生活重心，并在缘分安排下开始了第二春。

programme.title: 女王之家
programme.desc: 【心机渣男出轨妻子闺蜜为夺下豪门不择手段！】人人称羡的模范夫妻申明燮与韩善珠，在纪念婚礼当天揭开了幸福假象。出身豪门的善珠外表完美，内心却藏著被背叛的恐惧；出身贫寒的明燮，靠婚姻翻转人生却陷入外遇泥沼。而第三者尹美罗，不仅成为他的灵魂寄托，更在命运的捉弄下与善珠结为好友。当真相逐步揭开，爱与恨、正宫与小三的界线逐渐模糊，一场婚礼，也预告了一场悲剧的开始。

programme.title: 韩国小姐
programme.desc: 【2023百想最佳男主角李圣旻社区大叔们联手打造韩国小姐】高中时自恃美貌过人，而没有好好念书的吴智英，毕业后凭借外表当上百货的电梯小姐，看似光鲜亮丽的工作，背后隐藏著许多辛酸，面对毛手毛脚的变态上司，以及百货种种不合理的工作规定，年纪增长且缺乏竞争力另吴智英后悔莫及，偶然的机会下，与现职化妆品公司社长的前男友相遇，公司即将倒闭的金亨俊，与债主郑先生一同把平凡女孩打造为顶级韩国小姐的励志故事。

programme.title: 只属于我的你
programme.desc: 【渣男律师劈腿富豪千金李敏英逆袭成知名设计师】恩静与律师姜胜宰结婚后，原以为会享受奢华生活，但现实却是在婆家被当成佣人使唤。婆婆因恩静没有家世而感到丢脸，胜宰也渐渐冷淡，甚至不愿承认老婆。事实上，恩静发现胜宰根本没有办理结婚登记，当她为了帮助妹妹处理财务问题，办理贷款时才揭露了这个真相。不久后她发现老公与BJ集团继承人有染，决心离开伤心地，重返职场成为知名设计师。与此同时，昔日男友俊夏重新进入她的生活，默默支持她，希望能给她真正的幸福。

programme.title: 奔跑吧蔷薇
programme.desc: 【纨裤子弟情留落难千金，寻觅守护爱情的甜蜜配方】过著丰食无缺没有大小姐架子的蔷薇。一场家中巨变，面临相亲结婚丈夫的背叛，经济困境及失去原生家庭的后盾。困境中凭著对料理的热情及新生活，与食品公司会长的孙子相恋，奔向对方的路上还会遇上什么样的考验?

programme.title: 妈妈要出嫁
programme.desc: 【任劳任怨大半辈子的慈母觉醒切割贪财不孝子】因丈夫早逝，独自抚养四名子女的尹正爱，就如同天下所有的妈妈一样，为了孩子总是愿意牺牲自己，一路从路边的菜贩打拼，多年后与大女儿允姬开了间点心餐厅。正当一切都看似幸福美满时，孩子们的婚姻、事业、学业纷纷出现状况，在面对问题时儿女们总持相反意见，并只贪图母亲的遗产，让正爱深感背叛，在朋友的劝说下，正爱打算不再以孩子为生活重心，并在缘分安排下开始了第二春。

programme.title: 金装律师
programme.desc: 【改编人气美国影集，张东健×朴炯植联手成为法律界黄金拍档！！】头脑聪明，拥有过目不忘天才能力的高延宇，却因家境关系却步成为律师。混进了律师事务所遇上韩国顶级资深律师崔江锡。随著事件发生与时间相处成为黄金拍档，崔江锡要如何亦师亦友的带著没有正式念过大学也只是菜鸟律师的高延宇打出一片天下呢？

programme.title: 依法相爱吧
programme.desc: 【李升基×李世荣二次合作，青梅竹马谱出律政罗曼史！！】改编自人气网路小说，「怪物天才检察官」金正浩与「韩国小姐出身律师」金琉璃，青梅竹马重逢后，一起经营「LawCafé」的故事。既是律师事务所、又是咖啡馆的小天地里，用温暖的饮品与犀利的法律智慧，帮助无数人伸张正义。从法庭到日常，辩论化为斗嘴，正义化为浪漫，疗愈又甜蜜的爱情由此展开。

programme.title: 落花时节又逢君
programme.desc: 【小花妖胡意旋强撩告白高冷花神刘学义，大谈反差萌恋！！】不懂情爱、呆萌率直的小花妖红凝，为了报恩误闯仙界，却意外发现自己口中的「仙女姐姐」，竟是身为花神的锦绣。红凝大胆示爱，直言想当锦绣的「天后」，不是拉著他一起睡觉就是要陪他洗澡，让这位必须断情绝爱、恪守仙妖界限的未来天帝继承者瞬间乱了方寸。

programme.title: 金装律师

programme.title: 步步惊心
programme.desc: 那一天，张晓的命运被一场车祸彻底改写。她眼看著那辆失控的卡车将自己的灵魂撞出了躯体，而她，既没有进医院也没有进天堂，却是被撞进了清朝的宫廷中。就像铺天盖地的穿越小说里写的那样，张晓的灵魂跨过时间的隧道，在一个叫马尔泰.若曦的十六岁清朝女孩的体内，重生了…时年，康熙第四十三。天下太平，但一场震动历史的「九龙夺嫡」正在暗潮涌动。权利的厮杀，爱情的灼烧，在被无限放大的历史舞台上，张晓，不，是马尔泰•若曦的命运无可避免的与众位亲王阿哥们交织在一起…她知道自己不该卷入这场九王夺嫡的争斗中，可心不由己，因为这里有她所爱的，也有爱著她的…若曦最后选择的究竟是温润如玉的八阿哥，还是面冷心热的四阿哥，又或是出人意料的其他人?等历史的风云过后，可以陪她看夕阳西下、云卷云舒的又将是谁？

programme.desc: 【《千元律师》南宫珉恶斗《车贞淑医生》金炳哲，权贵复仇大秀帝王级演技！！】出身无名大学的罗以载，原为大学医院急诊中心的王牌，因医疗事故而吊销医生执照，重新考取医生执照并申请到监狱医疗科，开始进行复仇之路，成为监狱的医疗科长并成功掌握了名门大学医院理事会。真实体现没有自己不沾血就能打赢的战争。

programme.desc: 【李升基×李世荣二次合作，青梅竹马谱出律政罗曼史！！】改编自人气网路小说，「怪物天才检察官」金正浩与「韩国小姐出身律师」金琉璃，青梅竹马重逢后，一起经营「LawCafé」的故事。既是律师事务所、又是咖啡馆的小天地里，用温暖的饮品与犀利的法律智慧，帮助无数人伸张正义。从法庭到日常，辩论化为斗嘴，正义化为浪漫，疗愈又甜蜜的爱情由此展开。

programme.title: Troy the Train - Troy the Train - The Babies' trip to the Moon
programme.desc: The Babies are fascinated by the moon! Troy selects the most cosmic truck to help them get there: Rocky the Rocket!

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - QUACK-QUACK - SUPERJUMP! ROOKIE AND THE FROG
programme.desc: Rookie is sitting by a pond when he suddenly sees eyes staring at him from the water. Thinking of his friend the crocodile, he first keeps a safe distance, but then realizes that it is a cool frog that jumps out of the water and performs some awesome tricks. Rookie watches and tries to copy, and it doesn’t take too long to master such leaps, the frog being an excellent teacher. And when the frog finally falls, Rookie is fast enough to catch it and save it from harm.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - FLY, ROOKIE FLY! ROOKIE AND THE BIRD
programme.desc: Rookie is enjoying a sunny day when he spots a playful little bird drawing circles and shapes in the sky. Inspired to fly, Rookie climbs a tall tree to jump - but after a split second, the only way is down! Quickly, Rookie activates his parachute and lands safely. Although the bird is bursting with laughter, Rookie doesn‘t give u,p and with the help of a giant propeller, he manages to impress his new little friend.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - MOOOO WHO? ROOKIE AND THE BLIND COW
programme.desc: On his tour, Rookie discovers a small cow trapped in a pit and unable to escape on its own. He quickly rushes to its rescue and lifts it to safety. After helping the cow, Rookie realizes the cause of her fall: Very poor eyesight! Rookie presses a button, his body buzzing as he generates a pair of glasses. Rookie puts them on the little cow’s nose - and now she can see everything and even manages a high-fi ve to say goodbye before proudly taking off.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - PICTURE THIS! ROOKIE AND THE CAMERA
programme.desc: Rookie stumbles upon a device, picks it up, and as he goes to examine it, it flashes, and an instant picture comes out. Rookie is thrilled and immediately starts taking pictures of his entire surroundings from all sides and in all sorts of positions. Finally, he has a great idea: In his amazing new photo salon set up in a tent, photo artist Rookie will soon be waiting for all his friends to take wonderful portraits of them!

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - BOOKS ARE MAGIC! ROOKIE AND THE LIBRARY
programme.desc: Rookie finds a large library and is fascinated and attracted by all the colorful books. He picks up the first book, but gets frightened when the smiling shark on the cover turns into a ravenous biter after only one page. He chooses another book with a clown’s face and laughs at the funny pictures inside, then one about astronauts and the moon, and another with beautiful landscapes, before he finds an empty, completely white book that gives him a whole new idea.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - DANCE WITH YOUR FRIENDS – ROOKIE THE DJ
programme.desc: On his hike, Rookie discovers a strange, shiny globe hanging from a tree. He gently taps it, and the ball immediately begins to spin, reflecting the light beautifully in all directions: A disco ball! Just behind i, the Rookie finds a DJ booth and soon the music starts and the party begins! Lights are flashing, and all his buddies show up to have a dance with their friends under the sparkling disco ball.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - MY SAND IS MY CASTLE! ROOKIE AND THE CRAB
programme.desc: Rookie enjoys a beautiful day by the sea, playing in the warm sand. He starts to build a sandcastle, which soon gets bigger and bigger soon and notices a crab, which is interested in his building and starts to explore it like his own house. There is a new idea! He presses a button and becomes as small as the little friend, and together they play games inside the sandcastle, before their fun is interrupted by a big wave.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - FRIENDS IN THE SKY, FRIENDS FLYING HIGH? ROOKIE AND THE CLOUDS
programme.desc: What could be better than a meadow of flowers on a beautiful day? Rookie is enjoying the sun and the beautiful blue sky, watching the clouds pass by - but wait! What‘s that? One of the clouds turns, and suddenly its shape reminds him of one of his friends! And who is that again? What a fun game to play! Rookie continues to search for clouds that remind him of his friends and their adventures together.

programme.title: LMN's - LMN's - The castle of Robins
programme.desc: Since the lens fails to be recovered, Dr. No wants to make another, but he needs robins to make it. So he attacks Rubidia, a region filled with different precious stones. But Oxin the king of Rubidia makes Dr. No his prisoner. And locked him in the castle where Chip is also locked, as Oxin also makes them prisoners to make them work as slaves in his mines. Dr. No try to make Chip to give him back the lens, but Chip denies. Later, the two manage to escape from the castle and Dr. No chases Chip with his craft. But the boy gets the scientist falls into a trap and also helps free the slaves of Rubidia.

programme.title: LMN's - LMN's - The harmonica trap
programme.desc: Chip and his friends create a zone with formations resembling musical instruments and make sounds harmonious. Suddenly, they become trapped within a rectangle of quartz crystals that vibrate when they form a sonic trap. A musician atom who has caught them, seeks members to assemble an orchestra. The antimatters are near and Chip asked the musician to prepare the trap to retain them and escape. The musician agrees and the antimatters are prisoners of the musician that makes them hear the terrible sound of his compositions.

programme.title: Forbidden Tales of Two Cities
programme.desc: Li Han-hsiang wrote and directed this charming and fascinating comedy, Forbidden Tales Of Two Cities. The two cities in the picture are Macau, where a love quartet is a morally-unsound source for sexual entertainment; and Hong Kong, where a woman enters a gambler's apartment to find four shackles hanging from his ceiling to aid in kinky activities.

programme.title: Gambler's Delight
programme.desc: The Killer star Danny Lee plays the lead role of a guy who needs to become a hero. He lies, steals and cheats his way into operating a plush casino, but when he incurs the wrath of a female Japanese gang leader, all bets are off!

programme.title: Young Lovers
programme.desc: Guitar-playing rich kid, Yang Fan, heads to Japan to join a rock 'n' roll band where he soon finds himself competing for the affections of two beautiful girls.

programme.title: Crazy Shaolin Disciples
programme.desc: The story revolves around three lay disciples of the Shaolin Temple: Fang Shi Yu, Hong Xi Guan, and Hu Hui Qian. Monk Jie instructs them in martial arts, but their frequent competitions with fellow disciple Wu Qing spark rivalries. The once serene Shaolin Temple is plunged into chaos, yet even the abbot cannot help but be amused by their antics.

programme.title: Tales of Larceny
programme.desc: Connecting all the antics of bosses, monks, beggars, and thieves is the slippery and sinuous efforts of three pickpockets so adept at their chosen skill that they can even trick three beauties of their underwear without missing a step.

programme.title: My Rebellious Son
programme.desc: A corrupt official attempts to steal a priceless Buddha statue from a temple to please a group of Westerners. Luckily, Doctor Zhang and his son manage to defeat the Western boxers, the Japanese Kendo opponents and the Western longsword fighters with Chinese kung fu, thus saving the Buddha statue.

programme.title: My Dream Boat
programme.desc: This is a story about the complicated love relationships between a group of young friends who are entangled in a web of love and emotions.

programme.title: The Kid with the Golden Arm
programme.desc: The government hires Yang to escort a cargo of gold to a famine stricken area. The vicious Chi Sha gang, with one of their best fighters, Golden Arm, announce their intention to hijack it by killing one of Yang's employees. As Yang gathers his own team of reputable fighters to protect his cargo, are they strong enough to hold off Golden Arm?

programme.title: Gossip Street
programme.desc: All neighbours gather to gossip in flat number 8 on the second floor of the Gossip Street apartment building! Most of the residents are common people from all walks of life and there is never a lack of laughter or sarcasm in the neighbourhood. However, when a local mobster wants to change the place into a gambling den, things get serious...

programme.title: Trilogy Of Swordsmanship
programme.desc: A kung fu anthology film consisting of three stories: a man embarrasses himself while trying to prove his worth to the father of the woman he loves; a courtesan in love with a general will need to deliver a notorious bandit in exchange for him not being executed; and a group of bandits forms a plan to rescue a new friend from being executed.

programme.title: Rose, Be My Love
programme.desc: Not a love triangle but a love 'rectangle', Rose, Be My Love is a romantic drama set on the eve of World War II that represents the high standards achieved by Shaw Brothers in both aspects of star power and technical polish.

programme.title: Legendary Weapons of China
programme.desc: Lei Kung, the leader of the Boxer Clan in Yunnan, dissolves the clan to save his disciples before going into self-exile. The Clan sends various assassins to kill him but failed. They then assigned Kung's brother Yong to find and kill Kung, leading to a battle between the two brothers.

programme.title: The Land of Many Perfumes
programme.desc: Monk Tang San Zang, Monkey, Pigsy and Sha Wu Jing find themselves in Womanland, where women only give birth to baby girls and do so by drinking the magical spring water.

programme.title: Dirty Ho
programme.desc: Master Wang, who is actually the 11th prince, poses as an antique connoisseur to hide his true identity. When he meets Dirty Ho, a witty con artist, Wang knows he has found the right man to help him untangle a royal succession plot...

programme.title: Hell Has No Boundary
programme.desc: Cheng Chung (Derek Yee) and May (Liu Hsueh-hua), a pair of lovers working on the police force, camp on an outlying island. Awakened by a strange sound, May goes out onto the beach where a violent frenzy grips her. After her return from leave, May insists Inspector Wang (Yueh Hua) in a bid to rescue some hostages. She shoots the thug under most peculiar circumstances. Then a series of tragedies occur.

programme.title: Hell Has No Boundary
programme.desc: Cheng Chung (Derek Yee) and May (Liu Hsueh-hua), a pair of lovers working on the police force, camp on an outlying island. Awakened by a strange sound, May goes out onto the beach where a violent frenzy grips her. After her return from leave, May insists Inspector Wang (Yueh Hua) in a bid to rescue some hostages. programme.title: Murderer Pursues
programme.desc: Wang Chung was a valued actor long before he became a director, but as a filmmaker, he helped create some of the most interesting thrillers Shaw Brothers ever released - including this fascinating crime saga of a Sino-Vietnamese crime gang. Danny Lee stars as a misunderstood refugee while Ray Lui plays a cop struggling against his own conscience to ensure that justice is upheld.

programme.title: The Millionaire Chase
programme.desc: It's a fun and wild romp that mixes pleasure with pleasure. A nightclub owner, playboy Peter Chen Ho, has his ways with three sisters while gallivanting across Asia. Each one has a dangling relationship to save - ensuring a series of mishaps and comic moments.

programme.title: Brave Archer And His Mate
programme.desc: Guo Jing and Huang Rong raise the son of his sworn brother Yang Kang and named him Yang Guo. To prevent Yang Guo from taking revenge for his father's death, Huang Rong bans him from learning martial arts. Yang Guo runs away from home in anger and encounters Ouyang Feng, who teaches him the "Toad Stance" and accidentally unveils his true identity...

programme.title: Emperor Chien Lung and the Beauty
programme.desc: Emperor Chien Lung meets a famous courtesan in Suzhou and in order to spend as much time as possible with her, he builds a direct underground tunnel into the Forbidden City. The emperor's sudden appearances through this direct access shock his people but it is also at this time that he helps the needy and cracks the gambling business in Suzhou.

programme.title: The Thundering Sword
programme.desc: Two disciples, Yu and Zheng, are sent by their master to track down the invincible weapon "Thundering Sword" to prevent villains from getting it. Yu encounters the daughter of a ruthless clan, Chiao, who is on her way to seek for the sword. They quickly fall for each other, but when Chiao accidentally injures Zheng, things become complicated.

programme.title: Hex after Hex
programme.desc: Hell may have no fury like a woman scorned, but hell literally, really has no wrath like a lusting ghost scorned! Cult classic director Kuei Chih-hung shoots the works with this amazing horror romance starring muscular "Venom" Lo Meng.

programme.title: The Tigress Of Shaolin
programme.desc: Sam is being hunted as he discovers that the mayor and the chief of medical bureau are colluding with a drug dealer. He is saved by a fishermen family and works in their friend's grocery but the grocery owner is killed when the enemies track Sam down. Sam escapes to Shaolin to learn the cudgel style of kung fu in order to avenge his friends.

programme.title: Forever Diamonds
programme.desc: Hua, a pretty fraud, steals a brilliant diamond ring from a shop in Hong Kong and escapes to Singapore. To smuggle the ring pass customs, Hua slips it into the pocket of a stranger, Yen, but then lost track of him. Hua finally spots Yen after searching for days and does everything to get close to him in order to take the ring back.

programme.title: Return of the Sentimental Swordsman
programme.desc: One of Shaw Studio's highest grossing movies ever, this is the story of Li Chin Huan, the renowned, charming and sentimental swordsman who must fight many opponents, including an evil Clan Chief, for a place in the martial arts world.

programme.title: The Shepherd Girl
programme.desc: In this musical drama, Hsiu Hsiu, a beautiful shepherd girl, falls in love with a handsome boatman Ta Lung. However, she cannot afford to marry him because of her father's towering debt from gambling. To complicate the matter, a rival suitor promises to pay off all her father's debts on one condition: that Hsiu Hsiu marries him...

programme.title: Pursuit of a Killer
programme.desc: The charm of Pursuit Of A Killer lies in the long awaited reunion of Five Venoms duo, Lo Meng and Sun Chien; Lo Meng, who plays a Mainland Chinese criminal escapee to Hong Kong in search of a better life, and a cop (Sun Chien) who helps him adjust to Hong Kong life while tracking down his mysterious killer at the same time.

programme.title: River of Tears
programme.desc: Retired singer Fang lives happily with her husband and son. Tragedy happens when a man from her past returns to haunt her. In an ensuing struggle to free her from his clutches, her husband dies in a car accident. Blamed by her father-in-law for her husband's death, Fang gets chased out of the house and goes back to singing to make a living...

programme.title: The Duel
programme.desc: After knowing his brother has killed the head of a rival triad, Jie takes the blame and was hunted by killers. With the help of Rambler Nan, Jie finally killed his enemies, but then found out that Nan is the one who has killed his father.

programme.title: The Cave of Silken Web
programme.desc: In this third instalment of Shaw Brother's Journey to the West, Monk Tang San Zang is trapped by seven seductive spider spirits who are hell-bent on achieving immortality by eating him! Monkey, Pigsy and Sha Wu Jing have to fight the spider spirits to rescue Monk Tang San Zang.

programme.title: The Cave of Silken Web
programme.desc: In this third instalment of Shaw Brother's Journey to the West, Monk Tang San Zang is trapped by seven seductive spider spirits who are hell-bent on achieving immortality by eating him! Monkey, Pigsy and Sha Wu Jing have to fight the spider spirits to rescue Monk Tang San Zang.

programme.title: Swordsman at Large
programme.desc: Hsiao Shi Yi Lang is the Swordsman at large who everyone wants to kill. A magnificient sword is even created for this purpose though the blade is soon coveted more than the swordsman's death by it! Bandits, beauties and blade masters battle for survival in this exciting story of deceit, betrayal, and death.

programme.title: Summer Heat
programme.desc: Aptly described by its original title of "Money, Sex And Love", this is a gripping drama about Judy, a woman with a rich husband as well as two lovers who happen to be brothers. Jenny Hu is Judy, and her knockout beauty makes this summer sizzle...

programme.title: My Name Ain't Suzie
programme.desc: Young Mei Li works as a bar girl in Wanchai to make a living. When she meets Jimmy in the bar, she thinks he is her true love and falls crazily in love with him. When Jimmy has to leave, Mei Li is devastated. It is not until she encounters the triad boss Ying that she finally found someone to count on.

programme.title: The Perfumed Arrow
programme.desc: A charming Huangmei Opera title, this is the story of Fei E, a General's daughter who grows up fooling everyone that she is a boy, including her two closest schoolmates. When she has to choose one of them to marry, how will Fei E tell them that she is a girl? To complicate matters, a girl who Fei E saves one day only wants to be married to her!

programme.title: The Adventures of Emperor Chien Lung
programme.desc: Emperor Chien Lung travels incognito to Jiangnan to review his people's livelihood but soon discovers that corrupt officials are oppressing his people. The emperor meets an upright young man and they join hands to teach the corrupt officials a lesson. The young man was appointed as his bodyguard thereafter.

programme.title: The Magnificent Swordsman
programme.desc: The Magnificent Swordsman centres on the hero who vows vengeance against evil bandits who killed his family when he was a child. The hero recruits several friends to help the peasants rid their village of marauding bandits, the leader of the band being the man who killed his family.

programme.title: The Love Eterne
programme.desc: Ying Tai disguises herself as a boy to go to school and falls hopelessly in love with her classmate, Shan Bo. After Shan Bo realizes her true identity, he proposes marriage to Ying Tai. However, they are kept apart as she is engaged to another man. Knowing Shan Bo died in despair, Ying Tai is in deep sorrow and kills herself at his grave.

programme.title: The Shadow Boxer
programme.desc: Skilled shadow Tai Chi boxer Ku Ting hides his skills by working as a construction worker. However, when the thugs assaulted his girlfriend, Ku Ting has no choice but to use his kung fu to show his enemies what it takes to keep justice in line.

programme.title: Madam White Snake
programme.desc: Linda Lin Dai is perfect as Pak Su-cheng, the stunning snake goddess who assumes a womanly form so that she can taste the pleasures of a human life! Pak seduces young scholar, Hsu Hsien when she recognises him as her saviour in another life 1,000 years ago. But when Buddhist monk Fa Hai finds out about the union, the pair is forced to split...

programme.title: Executioners From Shaolin
programme.desc: The White-Browed Priest supports the brutal Qing government, burning down Shaolin Temple and hunting its disciples. Shaolin's Hung falls in love with Fang while escaping the hunt and the couple have a son before Hung is killed by the Priest. To avenge his father, Hung's son creates a new form of martial art combining his parents' kung fu styles.

programme.title: The Female Prince
programme.desc: Hsiao's stepmother frames her fiance Lung when he refuses to forfeit their engagement and sends him to prison. To save him, Hsiao disguises as Lung to take the Imperial exam and ranks first place. Impressed by Hsiao, the Emperor weds the Princess to 'him'. When Hsiao comes clean on their wedding night, she persuades the Princess to follow a plan...

programme.title: Heroes Of Sung
programme.desc: Heroes Of Sung stars one of the original kung fu ladies of the silver screen, Shih Szu, who plays swordswoman Meng Hung. She must work with Fan Tien-Fu, played by Lo Lieh to find and protect the royal seals of the Sung Dynasty. Shih's magnificent performance earned her the female hero role in another hit Dracula And The 7 Golden Vampires.

programme.title: The Dream of the Red Chamber
programme.desc: Adapted from the great Chinese classic novel of the same name, the son of renowned Jia family, Bao Yu, is deeply in love with his cousin, Dai Yu. However, his mother disapproves of their relationship and plots to arrange Bao Yu to marry another rich girl, resulting in a tragic ending for the perfect couple.

programme.title: Killer Constable
programme.desc: Kuei Chih-hung was famous for his modern day crime thrillers, his horror flicks, and even his comedies. But if the only kung-fu film he ever made was this one, he'd still be spoken of with respect by even the most ardent martial arts movie fan. Many consider this real life martial arts champion Chen Kuan-tai's best performance. As a deeply, even obsessively, dedicated Chief Court Constable, he illuminates the screen with fighting skill and emotional passion.

programme.title: Hong Qi Qu - EP8
programme.desc: CCTV brings you broadcasts of finely-produced artistic dramas that closely follow the pulse of the times.

programme.title: How to Choose a Royal Bride
programme.desc: The Empress Dowager has arranged for a Minister’s daughter Qiong Yao, to become Emperor Kangxi's concubine. However, Qiong Yao escapes in pursuit of freedom in marriage and Kangxi is happy to not go through with the union. When Kangxi travels incognito to Jiangnan, he serendipitously encounters Qiong Yao, who disguises herself as a man...

programme.title: Detrimental
programme.desc: You Ji Ren is a blind man who works at a factory in an outlying island. When the factory is cut off from the outside world by a hurricane one day, a monster appears and turns whoever sees it into black shadows. As You cannot see the monster, he is able to help other coworkers leave safely and fight to kill the monster!

programme.title: Deep in the Sea
programme.desc: Suspended psychiatrist Huang is asked to treat Zhao who suffers from schizophrenia. Zhao can only release himself from the pain of his girlfriend's death by killing people in his delusion. During the treatment, Huang is gradually affected by Zhao. He soon finds the way to cure Zhao, but then discovers an important secret about himself.

programme.title: Mr. Virgin
programme.desc: Mr. Virgin is a romantic comedy about a twenty-nine year-old man Chao Yu-ting (Alfred Chang) who has seemingly been cursed. He becomes paranoid when a Feng Shui expert tells him it will be unlucky for him to marry before the age of thirty... so comical chaos line the days up to his next birthday!

programme.title: Inside The Boys
programme.desc: Adapted from a true paranormal event, it is said that people working in the morgue at midnight encounter haunted events as many dead bodies are kept in the college hospital. When a few medical students experience a series of horrifying incidents after leaving the morgue at midnight, the campus is shrouded in terror.

programme.title: Wusong VS Ximenqing
programme.desc: Wu Song finds out about his sister-in-law’s affair with a rich man, Ximen Qing. Qing sets Song up and have him exiled for a year, during which his hapless brother is murdered and cremated. When Song finally returns home, he takes the case to court but the judge brushes it aside and closes it abruptly. Can Song finally avenge his brother’s death?

programme.title: Get in the Dark
programme.desc: A reporter hears three horror stories when investigating a case of the paper doll spirit 20 years ago. Miss Qiao had died in vain then, and her butler paid a paper craftsman to make a paper doll to be buried with her. Miss Qiao’s spirit is revived to take revenge when the doll’s eyes are drawn, and a series of horrible events begins to happen...

programme.title: Royal Tramp
programme.desc: Wei Xiao Bao is sent by a revolutionary group to be a spy in the imperial palace and find "The Sutra of 42 Chapters". Xiao Bao soon befriends Emperor Kang Xi but must carry out his mission at the same time, so he is caught between two camps.

programme.title: Blind War
programme.desc: Former SWAT captain Dong Gu suffers traumatic visual loss during a failed mission for which he is forced to take responsibility. He manages to get over and adapt to the situation with his daughter’s company, until his nemesis appears and puts his daughter in danger. Despite being blind, Dong Gu must fight to save his daughter.

programme.title: Mother VS Mother
programme.desc: Guan De Xing fell in love with Li Xiao Yun when he was young, but was opposed by his mother and had to marry Zhou Shen Yu. Since then, Li holds a grudge against Zhou. Unfortunately, the son of Guan and Zhou falls in love with Li’s daughter, and as the two mothers meet, they start brawling again!

programme.title: The Flying Mr. B
programme.desc: Mr. Shi, a secondary PE teacher, accidentally takes a "super pill" invented by the science teacher and gains superpower, turning into Mr. B. He uses his superpower to help the school sports team win the championship and prevent crimes. When the triad is made aware of Mr. B’s superpower, they try to gain the super pill for nefarious purposes.

programme.title: Initial D
programme.desc: The movie is adapted from a famous Japanese manga. 18-year-old Takumi delivers tofu in his father's near-obsolete car every day and becomes a good racer with perfect drifting skill. Encouraged by his father, he joins a mountain race and unexpectedly wins it, making him famous overnight and leading him from one exciting race to another.

programme.title: Hong Kong Playboys
programme.desc: Sheng is a rich playboy who lives a carefree and fun life with the ladies, until his mother decides that he should get married. Up against other lady killers in his quest to find Miss Right, Sheng must decide what he wants.

programme.title: Whatever You Want
programme.desc: An illegitimate daughter of a businessman gets three wishes from a genie, Bo. However, Bo's magical power is far from perfect, leading to much hilarity in this charming fantasy comedy.

programme.title: Hero
programme.desc: Ma Wing Jing and his brother arrive in Shanghai to make their fortune. Befriending a powerful mobster Tam, Ma is given his nightclub when he saves Tam’s life. Ma’s fortune rises but he must overcome the corruption and violence to survive.

programme.title: Face to Face
programme.desc: Tamotsu dies in a skiing accident and his roommate Yoshio marries his wife as well as inherits his entire fortune. At Tamotsu's funeral, Yoshio sees a badly disfigured old man and that is only the beginning of an evil downfall for him...

programme.title: Face to Face
programme.desc: Tamotsu dies in a skiing accident and his roommate Yoshio marries his wife as well as inherits his entire fortune. At Tamotsu's funeral, Yoshio sees a badly disfigured old man and that is only the beginning of an evil downfall for him...

programme.title: Look Out, Officer!
programme.desc: Stephen Chow is a delight in this supernatural action comedy, where a murdered police officer returns from beyond the grave to persuade a rookie cop into avenging his death.

programme.title: Perfect Girls
programme.desc: Chi will inherit his dying grandfather’s fortune with one condition - he has to be married in a month, otherwise the money goes to his uncle, Robert. Chi falls in love with Siu Siu, but Robert intends to stop them by sending Moraine to seduce Chi. When Moraine decides to marry Chi for money, Robert stops her and reveals their plot.

programme.title: WIFI
programme.desc: Li Hong Shan’s wife died in a car accident. One year later, he suddenly receives a message from his dead wife. Li vows to save his wife's life through this time transcending WIFI signal, but ends up uncovering a bigger conspiracy behind...

programme.title: Royal Tramp II
programme.desc: The leader of Dragon clan, Long Er, helps General Wu to overthrow Emperor Kang Xi. However, Long Er is betrayed by General Wu and is rescued by Xiao Bao. As a result, she bestows her virginity and martial arts power to Xiao Bao to fight against Wu. At the same time, Xiao Bao fortuitously unveils the hidden treasures from "The Sutra of 42 Chapters".

programme.title: Fate Jealous Greed
programme.desc: The film consists of three short horror stories: a man tries to survive after he received a haunted mail predicting his death; while a man mourns the death of his beloved wife, she becomes a ghost and tries to communicate with him; three brothers clash over the care options of their elderly mother during dinner, leading to a terrifying murder.

programme.title: The Mask of Shura of Fire Cloud
programme.desc: 18 years ago, the evil Black Feather clan infiltrated the territory of Master Fire Cloud and stole The Mask of Shura, thus releasing an evil spirit that was a baby. Master Fire Cloud adopted the baby to prevent him from becoming evil. When the baby grows up, he takes control of the mask and becomes Fire Cloud’s successor as the city’s guard.

programme.title: The Sorcerer &amp; The White Snake
programme.desc: In this action fantasy movie based on the Chinese legend of the White Snake, a young herbalist falls in love with a thousand-year-old white snake disguised as a woman. When the white snake's true identity is revealed, a sorcerer goes to battle believing that in doing so, he is restoring balance and order between man and the supernatural.

programme.title: Mr. Possessed
programme.desc: Riley is cursed by an evil spirit to not be able to approach any woman. When he falls in love with Siu Yu, Riley’s mother decides to use her to help him vanquish the evil spirit. On their wedding night, Riley passes out after protecting Siu Yu from the attack of the evil spirit. Can the two finally break the curse?

programme.title: Destiny's Champion
programme.desc: An aging fighter relives the mistakes of his violent past through a poor and streetwise kid, who severely injures his nemesis during a battle to win a girl's heart.

programme.title: Challenge of the Gamesters
programme.desc: A gambling master and his partner are hired by the government to investigate another gambler who may be working as a Japanese spy in Shanghai.

programme.title: PTU
programme.desc: When OCTB (Organized Crime And Triad Bureau) officer, Sergeant Lo Sa, loses his police revolver to four triad young thugs, he seeks help from Sergeant Mike Ho of the PTU (Police Tactical Unit) to find his lost revolver. Ho and his patrolling PTU team has until dawn to recover the gun and clean up the mess.

programme.title: How to Pick Girls Up !
programme.desc: Xin, a helpless loser in love, calls in to a radio show hosted by DJ Tsang to ask desperately for help. A self-proclaimed love expert, Tsang takes it upon himself to make sure Xin meets girls and leads him on a series of absurd excursions into the wild and dangerous world of modern love.

programme.title: Let's Make Laugh
programme.desc: When a young housewife’s debt-ridden, philandering husband leaves her with a mountain of tax debts, a security guard is hired by the tax authority to guard the assets, but he starts falling for her instead.

programme.title: The Magnificent Scoundrels
programme.desc: Conman Sing is forced by a loan shark to team up with another con artist Betty to steal from a luxurious house. When they encounter other conmen who disguise themselves as the house owners to steal the antiques, they pretend to be their rich guests. As both sides know the other’s true identity, they join forces to con the loan shark into a trap.

programme.title: King Of Beggars
programme.desc: So was born a nobleman but is relegated to a beggar after being caught cheating. He becomes the chief of the Beggar’s gang when he saves the gang’s elder. One day, So foils an assassination attempt on the Emperor and is allowed to reinstate his status but he declines. He is then rewarded with an imperial beggar bowl and lives happily ever after.

programme.title: King Of Beggars
programme.desc: So was born a nobleman but is relegated to a beggar after being caught cheating. He becomes the chief of the Beggar’s gang when he saves the gang’s elder. One day, So foils an assassination attempt on the Emperor and is allowed to reinstate his status but he declines. He is then rewarded with an imperial beggar bowl and lives happily ever after.

programme.title: Impermanence
programme.desc: A series of strange events is happening in a peaceful village, including a corpse that is resurrected from its grave and ran away. As the villagers investigate, a villain dies and the village head also goes missing. Police investigation ensues, but as the truths start to unveil, more mysteries are unfolding. Who is the one behind them all?

programme.title: The Illegal Immigrant
programme.desc: This is a gritty and realistic Chinatown tale about the life of a Chinese illegal immigrant and his journey in New York. He is looking for a fake marriage with a girl so as to gain the right of abode there. Despite all the hardships and misfortunes, he tries to cope with life and reach for his dreams.

programme.title: The Case of Disappearances
programme.desc: In Misty Village, the adopted son Wen Jie is haunted by a recurring nightmare. He delves into a series of disappearance cases in the village to seek his true identity. As more villagers die mysteriously, belief in the curse of Emperor Jing Lung intensifies. Wen Jie teams up with the security chief to unveil the conspiracy and protect the villagers.

programme.title: Casino Tycoon II
programme.desc: This is a sequel to "Casino Tycoon". 20 years after Benny Ho established his casino empire in Macau, his former partner becomes envious and plots to bring him down. At the same time, a young man working for Benny is the son of his ex-lover, and is also out to take revenge on him. Ho however, is not about to take things lying down...

programme.title: Legend Of The Dragon
programme.desc: A young man Lung leaves his rural home on a small island to seek fortune in Hong Kong. His uncle cons Lung to play in a snooker tournament using his father’s land as the bet. Lung lost the match but luckily, his childhood friend Momo encourages him to compete again using her land as the bet. Can he finally win his land back?

programme.title: Never Leave
programme.desc: Strange incidents keep happening in Lin Yue's house after a car accident: her sister cannot see the images of her family members in the mirror; her father is peeping at night; and there is the sound of marbles from the attic every day at dawn. Following the sound to the attic, Lin Yue finds her own death portrait as she opens the door...

programme.title: The Fox Demon Love
programme.desc: Adapted from a story in the novel "Strange Tales from Liaozhai", a young student in the late Ming Dynasty meets a charming fox demon and they soon fall in love. Though they encounter several obstacles due to their different nature, the lovers continue to fight against fate. Can they finally be together?

programme.title: Teenage Dreamers
programme.desc: Ting Ting is a student in an all-girl high school. She tries out for the school’s stage production of Romeo and Juliet with an all-boy school and promptly falls for the lead, Jackson. While Ting Ting is swept away by the excitement of her first love, Jackson turns out to be more of a player than a partner.

programme.title: Those Were the Days
programme.desc: Director Wong despises Cantonese movies of the 60s, but accidentally travels back in time to that movie set. He meets Director Chu, who tells him he can return to modern time if someone likes the film he makes. Wong meets four classic movie stars and invites them to star in his new film, but it flops unexpectedly. Can Wong return to the present?

programme.title: Maybe It's Love
programme.desc: A girl Marble witnesses a murder case and reports it to the police. After much investigation, the police can only sort out the complicated relationships between a rich merchant's mistress, a postman, a shop owner and his wife, but find no clue as to who the murderer is. Therefore, Marble decides to carry out her own investigation...

programme.title: Doubles Cause Troubles
programme.desc: Two squabbling cousins find themselves in more trouble than they can imagine after their tenant ends up dead. The gangsters and the police are both after them, and they have no idea what they have done wrong!

programme.title: Final Justice (1988)
programme.desc: Chang is a brilliant police inspector, but his maverick ways have put him at odds with both his superiors and peers. When he encounters Wai, a streetwise car thief who accidentally becomes the key to tracking down a gang of armed bank robbers, the two form an uneasy alliance to bring the criminals to justice.

programme.title: Winner Takes All
programme.desc: Two private detectives want to gain fame by solving a series of robberies. However, they were fooled by the King of Thieves during the investigation. It was later discovered that all the robberies were related to a Japanese businessman, Miyamoto. Who is the real King of Thieves?

programme.title: Law Or Justice
programme.desc: Lawyer Yip defends a rapist and gets him acquitted. Yip’s boyfriend Fong, a police inspector, knows he is guilty and despises Yip for not upholding justice. The victim’s sister takes revenge by spiking the rapist’s drink but is raped instead. This puts the rapist back in court. Will Yip choose to uphold law or justice this time?

programme.title: Mr Vampire Saga 4
programme.desc: A Buddhist monk and Taoist priest put aside their differences to take on vampires that have been struck by lightning and have now become a super powered threat to mankind.

programme.title: Fast & Furious: Spy Racers S1 - Ignition

programme.title: Fast & Furious: Spy Racers S1 - Escape from L.A.
programme.desc: Tony and his crew have been working as spy racers in LA for a while now and are itching to go international. programme.title: Trolls: The Beat Goes On! S2 - Don't Worry Be Peppy Two's A Cloud
programme.desc: When Poppy worries that her father doesn’t feel useful now that’s he’s no longer King, she asks her friends to bring Peppy small problems to solve. programme.title: Spirit Riding Free S1 - Lucky And The Treacherous Trail
programme.desc: When Lucky gets wind of an advanced trail ride she decides to become the best frontier girl anyone has ever seen.overnight

programme.title: Voltron: Legendary Defender S3 - Shadows
programme.desc: Left distraught after the battle with Voltron and the Sincline mech, Honerva begins to set her plans in motion. Glimpses of her past reveal what Honerva has been planning and how deep her emotional ties run.

programme.title: My Life Me S1 - The Makeover
programme.desc: Liam starts acting even stranger when he falls in love with an older woman:15-year-old Cynthia. Birch, Sandra and Raffi conspire to give Liam a complete makeover to make him more appealing. Their plans backfire, making Liam look crazy instead of attractive.

programme.title: My Life Me S1 - The Pom-Pom Girl
programme.desc: Sandra rises to the challenge of becoming a cheerleader, an act that stuns and mortifies her podmates. As Sandra succumbs to Amelia's ridiculous hazing rituals Pod 4 becomes increasingly uneasy. But we soon learn that Sandra is only doing back flips to ensure her nemesis' ultimate humiliation.

programme.title: My Life Me S1 - Unreasonable Facsimilies
programme.desc: Overhearing Mr. Towes' plan to throw a pop quiz Raffi uses the information to his advantage - by studying. However, Raffi's current obsession with texting has him including his own acronyms in his answers, thus creating irrefutable evidence for the teacher. Guilt finally undoes the pod with unlikely results.

programme.title: My Life Me S1 - Planets Maligned
programme.desc: After a less than stellar day, Birch finds consolation in the pages of The Gemini Daily Planner she finds while cleaning her room. Impressed with its seeming accuracy, soon she won't make a move without consulting the book much to the escalating annoyance of the pod. A startling last-minute revelation keeps the pod from blowing apart.

programme.title: Fifi and the Flowertots S3 - Naughty Twins
programme.desc: Stingo is frustrated that he is always getting caught trying to take food from the other tots. He persuades the twins to go round the garden for him collecting food… will the other tots realise what he is up to?

programme.title: Fifi and the Flowertots S3 - Shadows
programme.desc: Webby is clearing out her web. Fifi takes all the unwanted objects home and uses them to play a brilliant game of shadow puppets, a perfect game to play on a rainy day!

programme.title: Fifi and the Flowertots S2 - Bumble's Special Lunch
programme.desc: Fifi has invited the other tots over to lunch but she is not very well. Bumble gamely steps in and offers to cook for her. What could possibly go wrong?

programme.title: Fifi and the Flowertots S2 - Fifi Misses Me Not
programme.desc: Bumble has gone off on a pollen collecting expedition. He wishes Fifi was with him. Meanwhile, back in the garden, Fifi is missing her best friend too.

programme.title: Fifi and the Flowertots S2 - Pirate Primrose
programme.desc: The tots are playing at pirates, all except Primrose, who is being a princess, naturally. But guess which tot has the best pirating skills when they are needed

programme.title: Fifi and the Flowertots S2 - Primrose Loses It
programme.desc: Primrose has broken her new necklace and lost the beads. She is unconsolable. Violet holds a make and do party to replace the necklace

programme.title: Fifi and the Flowertots S2 - Dr Webby
programme.desc: Bumble's sneezing has got so bad, it is keeping everyone awake at night. Webby gives Fifi a recipe for a cure for sneezes… will it work?

programme.title: Fifi and the Flowertots S2 - Make Room For Fifi
programme.desc: There is a horrid smell in Fifi's garden. Fifi goes to stay with Primrose and Violet while they try and work out where the smell is coming from. What could be causing it?

programme.title: Olivia S1 - Olivia And Her Alien Brother
programme.desc: After a trip to the planetarium, Ian's knowledge about space and his peculiar behaviour lead Olivia to believe that her brother is an alien. Olivia soon discovers his secret…he's making a special gift for his favourite sister

programme.title: Olivia S1 - Olivia Plants A Garden
programme.desc: When Mrs. Hogenmuller distributes seeds for a class garden project, Olivia just can't wait for her plants to grow. But when her dog Perry digs up her little garden, Olivia discovers something even more exciting - what appears to be a dinosaur bone!

programme.title: Dragons: Rescue Riders S1 - Where There's Smoke
programme.desc: After Magnus accuses Cutter of setting fires near the village that could hurt the sheep, the Riders have to put them out and find the real culprit.

programme.title: Trolls: The Beat Goes On! S1 - Prank Day Adventures In Dinkles-Sitting
programme.desc: When Branch declares himself Prank Master Poppy gets evenTaking care of Mr. Dinkles is a bit harder than expected for Securityobsessed Branch.

programme.title: Trolls: The Beat Goes On! S1 - Eye'll Be Watching You Sorry Not Sorry
programme.desc: Convinced Troll Village is dangerous Branch makes a security plantPoppy creates an apology monster out of Gristle when teaching him how to make amends.

programme.title: Home: Adventures With Tip And Oh! S2 - Cats! The Planet Selfie-Ish
programme.desc: When Pig is abducted by a cat-lady-alien, Tip and Oh must travel to a cat-planet to save him; After Tip becomes a social media star, Tip gets addicted to "the likes," risking Oh's life in the process

programme.title: Home: Adventures With Tip And Oh! S2 - Newbeings On The Block Juicy Gossip
programme.desc: When an alien moves into the apartment above them, Oh thinks he's a threat to earth but nobody believes him; Oh befriends the Busy Bodies on Lucy's behalf

programme.title: Dinotrux Supercharged S3 - D-Stroy
programme.desc: DStructs quest to find the location of the supercharger leaves him in a tight situation

programme.title: Dinotrux Supercharged S3 - Doom Run
programme.desc: The team travels to the Wastelands not the Dooms. They meet the Speed Trux who convinces the team to participate in the Doom Run race to try and win the part they need to fix Skya.

programme.title: Not Quite Narwhal S1 - She Said, She Said Starfish
programme.desc: When one of Rikki’s plants won't sing, Pixie and Juniper both tell their varying recollections of why the plant is suddenly silent. Kelp, Scallop, and Cruz have always thought that starfish did nothing but laze about; but as they go about their day, the starfish goes through his own routine, completely unbeknownst to everyone else.

programme.title: Not Quite Narwhal S1 - Leroy’s Caterpillar Lost Spark
programme.desc: Leroy must learn to let go when his caterpillar friend turns into a butterfly. When Pixie loses her spark, Kelp and Juniper look for the plant they think will cure her. Meanwhile Pixie wonders whether she can be cured at all!

programme.title: Go, Dog. Go! S1 - Mom for a Day Kitty in the City
programme.desc: When Mom is sick on a busy day at home, Tag offers to pick up the slack and take on her tasks for the day. Tag handles it at first, but when the responsibilities start to stack up, she realizes that being Mom is much harder than she thought. \ Tag and Scooch are excited to get to know Kit, who has organized a bunch of cat-ivities for the day. But when Kit realizes she accidentally scratched up Frank and Beans’s tree, she, Tag and Scooch find a way to make it up to them.

programme.title: Go, Dog. Go! S1 - The Itch To Switch Mismatched Socks
programme.desc: When Tag is frustrated living in a crowded house, and Scooch is bored in a quiet house, the two friends switch houses for the day. At first they both love their new lives. But as Scooch gets overwhelmed by all the activity at The Barker house, and Tag gets bored by the quiet life at the Pooch’s, they eagerly switch back before the day is done. \ When the Pawston Get Sox go on a losing streak, Tag and Scooch come up with the idea to have a team mascot.

programme.title: Team Zenko Go S1 - You (Don't) Snooze, You Lose Save The Squasher
programme.desc: When the crew takes on a mission to help Ian get some rest for a Badminton Tournament, Jax realises that the biggest approach isn't always the best approach. When Lula loses her comic book, Ari learns that the best heroes rely on teamwork and not gadgets.

programme.title: Team Zenko Go S1 - Gopher it! A Glamping We Will Go
programme.desc: When a pesky gopher gets in the way of Fawna making her famous veggie stew, Niah learns to not let a bad experience, get in the way of doing good. When the inexperienced Rona has to step in for Donna, the team makes sure everyone has the best camping trip ever.

programme.title: Dew Drops Diaries S1 - The Fly-A-Long Unburied Treasure
programme.desc: When the Dews' Glitter Guide, Willow comes to check on the Dews’ progress, they feel like they’re failing to impress her, until Lola gets locked out of the apartment during a game of Hide-and-Seek and Dews work together to get her back inside. When the Dew Drops discover a time capsule in the park, they set out to find the mystery owner.

programme.title: Dew Drops Diaries S1 - Tooth on the Loose That Thing You Dew
programme.desc: When Phoebe convinces the Tooth Fairy to visit before Marcus has actually lost his tooth, the Dew Drops do everything in their power to make sure the tooth is out before she arrives! The Dews decide to hold a concert in the park for their animal friends, but can’t find the time to practice.

programme.title: Dawn Of The Croods S1 - Eep-Over Thunkytown
programme.desc: When Eep has the first-ever sleepover, scary noises and shadows send the girls screaming out of the cave; Thunk saves the day when Bear Owls invade.

programme.title: Dawn Of The Croods S1 - Mom Genes
programme.desc: When Grug takes Ugga hunting to find her inner growl again, she's as fierce as ever until coming face-to-face with a mom and baby too cute to catch.

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in the Crib S3 - War of the Cheeks
programme.desc: Boss searches for evidence that Tabitha's best friend is an Uncuddleable, but is sidetracked by a Templeton Family tradition: "The War of the Cheeks", a Go Fish tournament where the winner gets to make family rules for a whole day. When Yvette joins in, Boss has to keep her from winning, out of fear that an evil babysitter will make family rules that overturn the Templeton household.

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in the Crib S3 - Techy Tykes
programme.desc: Trying to win Tabitha's loyalty for Baby Corp, Boss and Tina invite her to Techy Tykes, a technology convention at their office. But when the top-secret UBO goes missing, the outsiders Tabitha and Tim (who's tagged along to relive his glory days) immediately become the number one suspects.

programme.title: Dragons: Race to the Edge S3 - Triple Cross
programme.desc: Hiccup teams with an unexpected person in search for an antidote when Toothless is seemingly poisoned

programme.title: Dragons: Race to the Edge S3 - Family Matters
programme.desc: The riders realize the Flyers are using the Deathsong to capture Singetails and plan a rescue mission to liberate them

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse S1 - Rainy Day Banana
programme.desc: With a little help from Gabby’s imagination, a sparkly toy banana turns into a magical Rainy Day Banana that helps Gabby and the Gabby Cats have fun on a rainy day! They have silly banana snacks with Cakey, make crafts to tell a story with Baby Box, and have an a-meow-zing banana dance party with DJ Catnip. For our Gabby Cat of the Day segment, Cakey sings a song!

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse S1 - CatRat The Bandit
programme.desc: The dollhouse is immersed in imaginative Wild West play with Sheriff Gabby, Sheriff Pandy, and CatRat the Bandit. Sheriff Gabby and Sheriff Pandy must safely deliver gold to the bank, but it gets confiscated by Bandit CatRat! They go on an adventure to get the gold back and restore order in the dollhouse.

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in the Crib S3 - Sitting Ducks
programme.desc: Boss, Tina, JJ, Dez and Pip willfully get babysat by the Uncuddleables, planning to expose them as horrible sitters via secret, hidden cameras. But the plan is thrown for a loop when Tina's first night alone without her parents makes her fall for their sitter Mia as a "substitute mommy." Meanwhile, Nannycam uses the babysitting distraction to sneak into the Uncuddleables' secret garage hideout to gather intel with her own "B field team."

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in the Crib S3 - The Big Dumpling
programme.desc: The Uncuddleables have struck the Lil Dumpling baby pageant, replacing all of Baby Corp's super-cute top 5%er babies with not-cute bottom 5%ers. Boss, Tina and their field team race to caravan the 5%ers from their homes to the pageant before Nannycam deploys the nuclear option of unleashing the dangerously cute UBO on stage to salvage a Lil Dumpling win.

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in the Crib S3 - The Great Medieval London Fire 1135
programme.desc: Boss Baby and Tina reject the 5%er system that says the cuter you are, the more love you deserve. Teaming up with the Uncuddleables, the team tries to take down the system from within, forming a resistance of the eight department heads of Baby Corp in the hopes of changing the way we look at Baby Love forever.

programme.title: The Epic Tales of Captain Underpants S1 - Captain Underpants and The Dreadful Debacle of DJ Drowsy Drawers
programme.desc: George and Harold attempt to save the fun at their school dance, but matters are made worse when their music teachers transforms into the dull yet deadly villain DJ Drowsy Drawers

programme.title: Fast & Furious: Spy Racers S1 - Born a Toretto
programme.desc: 17-year-old Tony Toretto and his gang are psyched when Dom recommends them to Ms. Nowhere for a spy racing job. Excited to get the opportunity to live up to Dom’s legacy, they use their street smarts and driving skills to infiltrate a race with SH1FT3R, a high-octane racing circuit whose drivers are all under 20.

programme.title: Fast & Furious: Spy Racers S1 - Enter SH1FT3R
programme.desc: Tony goes head-to-head with SH1FT3R’s main recruiter Layla Gray in a death-defying spy race through LA Tunnels, parking lots and construction sites. Tony’s awesome driving impresses Shashi Dhar (the head of SH1FT3R and the person Ms. Nowhere wants them to investigate), and after Tony and his crew pull a heist on a big rig full of energy drinks for Shashi, they’re officially accepted into the circuit.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: The Dragon Knight S2 - The Trial of Mr. Ping
programme.desc: There is more epic action and intrigue as Po and the Dragon Knights continue their quest to destroy the Tianshang weapons, but find themselves in treacherous waters when they are captured by pirates, one of which is out for revenge against Mr. Ping! The adventures lead them to London, where they are wanted by the Knights. Old enemies resurface and Blade will have to face one of her most challenging opponents-her mom.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: The Dragon Knight S2 - Baddie Issues
programme.desc: There is more epic action and intrigue as Po and the Dragon Knights continue their quest to destroy the Tianshang weapons, but find themselves in treacherous waters when they are captured by pirates, one of which is out for revenge against Mr. Ping! programme.title: Dawn Of The Croods S1 - Gran Day Out

programme.title: Dawn Of The Croods S1 - School Of Hard Rocks

programme.title: Happy Ever After - EP18
programme.desc: TUNG KOON (AU YEUNG CHUN WAH, BOBBY) born with a special ‘King’s Tongue’ is betrayed by his assistant, SIU SIU (CHAN MIU YING, MARIANE) who had prepared some chili source without permission. TUNG is accused of deceiving the Emperor and is forced to flee from Guangzhou to the capital. When SIU discovered that someone had used her to trap TUNG, she sees TUNG in person and apologizes. TUNG and SIU eventually reconcile. Love feeling blossoms between them.

programme.title: L'Escargot - EP27
programme.desc: Renovation contractor KWAN KA-ON (Miu Kiu Wai) is the elder of four siblings, while his wife SZE LONG-KIU (Sonija Kwok) is a typical housewife. Buying a house is their longtime dream. But when his eldest brother, KWAN KA-HONG’s business goes under, they shelve their plan to help him overcome his difficulties. KIU has to look for a job too.

programme.title: A Perfect Man - EP18
programme.desc: Yeung Yat-cheng (Joe Ma) has a good reputation in the realm of personal security. He is invited by his buddy Ha Chung-chau (Tsui Wing) to join a security company that is tasked with protecting a tycoon called Tseung Ding-tin (KK Cheung). While starting his new job, Yat-cheung is faced with personnel issues. Meanwhile, due to his unhappy childhood, Yat-cheng does not believe in marriage. However, he happens to hook up with Yau Chi-ching (Ali Lee).

programme.title: A STEP INTO THE PAST - EP24
programme.desc: HONG SHIU LUNG (KOO TIN LOK, LOUIS) is an secret agent in the 21st Century. He joins a pilot programme to fly back in time hoping that he will salvage his unforgettable love. However, something goes wrong during the mission. He is sent back to the Warring States Period. Emperor QI (LAM RAYMOND) has not been crowned yet and is kept hostage in Chiu. In order to return to the future, LUNG decides to help QI become emperor. With his wisdom and Kungfu, he is recognized and given important tasks.

programme.title: Plain Love II - EP18
programme.desc: ‘Fong’s tea’ is regarded as the finest in the trade. However, due to downfall of the family, its successor Yau Wai (Lam Ka Tung) can only earn his living by farming. WAI has two best friends, Hon Ngau (Mak Cheung Ching) and Wing Chun (Li Ka Sing, Dickson). They even become sworn brothers, share both happiness and bitterness._x000D_The three of them work in a huge tea garden of Sung’s family. Wai meets Ngai Mui (Cheung Ho Yee, Maggie) again, a girl from highlands.

programme.title: Shades of Life - EP102
programme.desc: Ko Ba-dou (Yu Yang), a retired school principal with a deep love for traditional Chinese culture, values ​​family ethics and is highly respected by his family. His eldest son, Ko Ho-pan (Wu Nuoyan), a journalism graduate and magazine editor, is a prodigy who seeks to get to the bottom of things. On livelihood issues, he occasionally disagrees with his father, holding different views.

programme.title: Hello Missfortune - EP3
programme.desc: In a multidimensional domain, Poon Siu-yu (Erica Chan) enters the second dimension after her death in the first dimension, i.e. the mortal realm. She then joins Office of the Life Authority and becomes a novice "destiny administrator". Siu-yu has to keep a close watch on food courier Chan Pei-ho (Hubert Wu), who is in the mortal realm. Pei-ho earns a meager living regardless of the weather. But his family members just do not care about him.

programme.title: Pages Of Treasures - EP2
programme.desc: Bookshop staff FONG HOK MAN (Chun Pui) always believes that "knowledge is power". He tries hard to encourage his older son FONG SUM MING (Lai Yiu Cheung) and his younger son FONG SUM CHING (Suen Eric) to study more. Unfortunately, MING is not good at studying at all and he quits after secondary school. On the other hand, CHING is a very smart boy and MING works hard overseas to support CHING’s further studies on computer sciences in America.

programme.title: The Price Of Greed - EP15
programme.desc: Police Constable LUI TO (WONG CHUNG CHAK, BOSCO) is shocked to discover that TSU FUNG (CHAN KIN FUNG, SAMMUL), who has reportedly gone missing for a year, is already dead and that his body has been claimed by his girlfriend LAM PING (TSUI KATE TSZ SHAN). Then, suddenly and mysteriously, FUNG, who is believed to be dead, turns up again, which makes the enigma even more intriguing. The relationship between PING and FUNG is also put to the test amidst such confusion.

programme.title: 风月同天-5分30秒版第31集
programme.desc: 「风月同天」此语出自八世纪日本长屋王赠予唐朝袈裟上的偈语：「山川异域，风月同天，寄诸佛子，共结来缘。」意指即使山川相隔，我们仍在同一片风与月之下，彼此牵系、共度风雨。影片以这份古老而永恒的慈悲为象征，映照出慈济志工在全球139个国家地区持续付出的身影—以行动，让爱无国界。这，就是慈济——一个由无数人的「小善」汇聚成世界之光的故事。

programme.title: 映照人生第488集
programme.desc: 印尼，是个超过两亿人口的东南亚大国，贫富差距极大，且语言文化种族差异均大。由印尼大爱台制作的「映照人生」，报导当地各面向的社会议题，从2010年起逐年获奖，被誉为是印尼正面纪录片的先驱之一。 制作团队都是由印尼的工作同仁，以在地观点，对印尼社会做深度观察，发现问题，报导当事人如何解决或面对，制作出一系列感人且启发人心的故事，传达以人道为关怀精神的节目内容。 本节目记录著印尼底层的人们，每个勇敢迎向苦难与希望的故事；也带领观众看见，这个世界的黑暗角落，因为人性的光辉，所映照出的光明。

programme.title: 法华经序HD中文版第1集

programme.title: 风月同天-5分30秒版第41集
programme.desc: 「风月同天」此语出自八世纪日本长屋王赠予唐朝袈裟上的偈语：「山川异域，风月同天，寄诸佛子，共结来缘。」意指即使山川相隔，我们仍在同一片风与月之下，彼此牵系、共度风雨。影片以这份古老而永恒的慈悲为象征，映照出慈济志工在全球139个国家地区持续付出的身影—以行动，让爱无国界。这，就是慈济——一个由无数人的「小善」汇聚成世界之光的故事。

programme.title: 风月同天-5分30秒版第48集
programme.desc: 「风月同天」此语出自八世纪日本长屋王赠予唐朝袈裟上的偈语：「山川异域，风月同天，寄诸佛子，共结来缘。」意指即使山川相隔，我们仍在同一片风与月之下，彼此牵系、共度风雨。影片以这份古老而永恒的慈悲为象征，映照出慈济志工在全球139个国家地区持续付出的身影—以行动，让爱无国界。这，就是慈济——一个由无数人的「小善」汇聚成世界之光的故事。

programme.title: 大爱学汉医第224集
programme.desc: 让世界看懂中医，打破中医的框架迷思，发挥预防重于治疗的优点，让台湾走向乐活社会。

programme.title: 人间菩提
programme.desc: 一年365天，一天15分钟， 证严上人以佛心应世事，结合台湾社会脉动、全球趋势，从后山看世界。

programme.title: 大爱年度剧展-芳草碧连天第24集
programme.desc: 这是台湾三代女性传承孝顺的历史缩影。 魏家三代女性的心路历程，从第一代阿罔，在艰困的环境中，没有失志，奋发面对生活的挑战，孝顺婆婆、支持丈夫及女儿，让大家都能好好活下去，与人为善，救贫治病，深受四邻亲友敬仰的精神里，影响著女儿高金英及孙女杏芬杏娟姊妹，他们传承阿妈的脚步，走过时代洪流，与家人彼此扶持，以孝顺回报阿妈和母亲。杏芬在美国听了「渡」的录音带把家人都度进慈济

programme.title: 大爱医生馆第6723集
programme.desc: 不断汲取新知，已是现代人必备的条件，对于人文精神的掌握，往往显得贫乏。大爱医生馆借由医师专业知识加上俯拾即是的美感经验与与回归人文思想的本怀，期望帮助忙碌的现代人多关心自己与周遭人的身心健康，为医疗节目注入生活化的素材。

programme.title: 纯美时光第13集
programme.desc: 骆纯美出生在台南的下营，爸爸骆焕宗在下营是个出名的裁缝老师，经常举办服装秀，父亲也经营电影院，从小与父亲感情甚好的纯美，二人就如朋友一般，无话不说，从小就生活在「美的事物」的纯美，也间接地感染到美感，父亲对于纯美的未来从不设限，让她自由发挥，在父亲的支持下与鼓励下，便让纯美梦想要当一个「艺术家」。 高中联考时，家中生意失败，让一心想要念「艺术系」的纯美，放弃梦想，转念师专，因此展开了她的老师生涯。师专毕业的纯美，向孔子立誓自己一定要当一个好老师，但纯美用热情对待学生，把学生留下来课辅，却让其他老师嫌恶，要她不要太认真，让她对「老师」的这个职业，产生了疑问。 为了离家近，纯美调到台南的乡下小

programme.title: 风月同天-5分30秒版第11集
programme.desc: 「风月同天」此语出自八世纪日本长屋王赠予唐朝袈裟上的偈语：「山川异域，风月同天，寄诸佛子，共结来缘。」意指即使山川相隔，我们仍在同一片风与月之下，彼此牵系、共度风雨。影片以这份古老而永恒的慈悲为象征，映照出慈济志工在全球139个国家地区持续付出的身影—以行动，让爱无国界。这，就是慈济——一个由无数人的「小善」汇聚成世界之光的故事。

programme.title: 仁心慧语第557集

programme.title: TRY科学第46集

programme.title: MIT台湾志第609集
programme.desc: 《MIT台湾志》是为台湾探访与见证前人留下历史足迹，为台湾这块土地留下一段完整纪录，并参照资料照片与麦觉明口头解说，令观众可以拼凑出当年历史。在每段广告之前，《MIT台湾志》会出现一则专题解说，是《MIT台湾志》另一项特色。《MIT台湾志》除富有历史文化探访纪录外，在探访路途上会不断探究与发现值得纪录之事，有：生态介绍、地质变化、新物种发现、辨认动植物、山岳特色与气候、术语解说、人文风情写实…等，这也见证了台湾前古后今、探史溯源的多元性纪录，是一部具有生态教学、文化品味、社会动态与价值变化的诠释，深深结合自台湾有开发历史以来，历经沧海桑田的岁月与战争留下的烙痕。

programme.title: MIT台湾志第610集
programme.desc: 《MIT台湾志》是为台湾探访与见证前人留下历史足迹，为台湾这块土地留下一段完整纪录，并参照资料照片与麦觉明口头解说，令观众可以拼凑出当年历史。在每段广告之前，《MIT台湾志》会出现一则专题解说，是《MIT台湾志》另一项特色。《MIT台湾志》除富有历史文化探访纪录外，在探访路途上会不断探究与发现值得纪录之事，有：生态介绍、地质变化、新物种发现、辨认动植物、山岳特色与气候、术语解说、人文风情写实…等，这也见证了台湾前古后今、探史溯源的多元性纪录，是一部具有生态教学、文化品味、社会动态与价值变化的诠释，深深结合自台湾有开发历史以来，历经沧海桑田的岁月与战争留下的烙痕。

programme.title: 霹雳靖玄录第11集
programme.desc: 霹雳封魔妖氛起，靖匡逆鳞系五玑。 玄祸方兴殛心劫，录异鲲鯩纳传奇。 随著虚无的力量扩散，神秘的南域亦受影响，风涛十二楼、麒麟阁、一局通神、论剑山庄能人辈出，各显风采。同时，神秘的禁忌长城、死亡三角洲，隐藏著武林未知的暗潮，神秘的浩劫，轩昂五玑在列的参天鹿帻占云巾、琴狐，将如何引领风骚，揭开禁忌之秘？ 崭新剧情，侠影鸿篇，且看五玑论战，并鳞乱世，血谱一卷风云史。道锋龙首，仙影侠踪，共题两阕靖玄录。

programme.title: 护心第31集
programme.desc: 灵龙天曜怀著满心喜悦准备和广寒门掌门素影成亲，谁知素影另有图谋，她计划取龙鳞制一件龙鳞铠甲，为护她真正所爱之人不伤不死，却不想天曜拼死在最后一刻将凝聚巨大灵力的护心鳞打出，素影大怒，将天曜的不死之身肢解，封印于大江南北。护心鳞飞跃山河，落入了一心口缺失的弃婴雁回胸膛，填补了雁回心脏缺失，让她得以活命。十年后，流浪的雁回被辰星山掌门凌霄收养，纳入辰星山成为他的弟子。因识海未开，灵力全无，仍是一星弟子，因此被同门嘲笑。一次偶然的机会，触发了雁回心口护心鳞的力量，灵龙之火瞬间烧毁了锁妖塔的结界，塔内的妖族趁机逃跑。凌霄得知后将其赶出辰星山，雁回误解了师父，觉得道不同不相为谋，便潇洒下山去永州成找好朋

programme.title: 欢喜来逗阵第56集

programme.desc: Kakudan为台湾原住民排湾语，「文化，惯习」的意思，希望可以从台湾原住民族隽永的文化，找到实践的道路。台湾原住民族在这块土地上已生活了八千年，祖先留下了珍贵的文化资产与族群智慧。惟因过去的历史面对不同时代的迁徙汉化与日治时期殖民政权的干扰，使得原住民传统文化的存续面临断层与式微的挑战。然而处于文化逐渐式微的困境，又面对长者生命的迅速凋零，我们如何抢救文化？如何教育下一代有正确的文化知识与视野？如何把传统说得更清楚？

programme.title: 大自然生趣第7集
programme.desc: 你知道台湾原生的鹿科动物总共有几种吗？你知道留鸟与夏候鸟的差别吗？你知道「南路鹰一万死九千」这句话的由来吗？你知道有哪些鸟是父亲负责孵蛋跟照顾小孩呢？ 请共下来了解，《大自然生趣》。 《大自然生趣》，照字面意思来说，是自然界中生生不息的各种生物所带来的许多趣味。很凑巧的，「生趣」这两个字，其实这是客语「有趣」的发音，因此换成客语来说，就是「大自然真有趣」。这个节目是将客籍生态纪录片导演刘燕明先生三十余年来上山下海，辛苦拍摄所得的丰富生态影像，以每集5分钟之短篇制作成有趣又具生态教育意义的短片，具有两大特色：1.生态专业团队制作：导演刘燕明先生与撰稿、旁白的邓庆煜先生，两人皆具备生态与纪录片拍

programme.title: 大自然生趣第8集
programme.desc: 你知道台湾原生的鹿科动物总共有几种吗？你知道留鸟与夏候鸟的差别吗？你知道「南路鹰一万死九千」这句话的由来吗？你知道有哪些鸟是父亲负责孵蛋跟照顾小孩呢？ 请共下来了解，《大自然生趣》。 《大自然生趣》，照字面意思来说，是自然界中生生不息的各种生物所带来的许多趣味。很凑巧的，「生趣」这两个字，其实这是客语「有趣」的发音，因此换成客语来说，就是「大自然真有趣」。这个节目是将客籍生态纪录片导演刘燕明先生三十余年来上山下海，辛苦拍摄所得的丰富生态影像，以每集5分钟之短篇制作成有趣又具生态教育意义的短片，具有两大特色：1.生态专业团队制作：导演刘燕明先生与撰稿、旁白的邓庆煜先生，两人皆具备生态与纪录片拍

programme.desc: 阿曼王国是阿拉伯半岛最贵重的珍宝，这是一块令人惊叹的美丽大地，充满了超乎想像的自然奇迹，并住著地球上最为稀有的动物，包括阿拉伯豹、阿拉伯剑羚、绿蠵龟与玳瑁。不仅如此，这里还有阿拉伯红狐、条纹鬣狗、鲸鲨及其他海洋生物。这里有各式各样的独特生物，而孕育著牠们的阿曼地貌也同样多样。

programme.title: 全球动物冒险王第6季:第10集
programme.desc: 史提夫贝克萧前往极少有人踏足的地点──巴西的蛇岛，这里是全球蛇类密度最高的地区。

programme.title: 一叶茶，千夜话第5集
programme.desc: 我们的旅程从杜拜繁忙的货柜港口开始，这里是茶叶贸易中心，数百万吨东方生产的茶叶经由此地航向西方。接著节目前往中国福建省实地观察「白茶」自然风干的优美制程，这种茶叶越来越受到欢迎，不只中国境内，在世界各地都颇具人气。

programme.title: 全球致命气候第6季:第8集
programme.desc: 飓风奥蒂斯重创阿卡普科，英国一座小镇被洪水吞没，佛罗里达遭遇骇人的龙卷风侵袭，义大利多处因豪雨淹水。

programme.title: 极限钓鱼第3季:第8集
programme.desc: 罗伯森寻找一些日本著名鱼类，包括以剧毒知名的河豚和其他鱼种。

programme.title: 渔人的搏斗维京篇第1季:第6集
programme.desc: 由于挪威巨蟹迟迟未现身，席格决定改捕红帝王蟹补齐订单，以免无法顺利交货。杰克请太太将爸爸的骨灰寄来船上，打算带著爸爸的骨灰一起出海捕蟹。

programme.title: 旧货猎人第10季:第11集
programme.desc: 本集节目中德鲁走访萨弗克拥有百年历史的皇家御用丝绸制造商，前往苏格兰高地一探克吕尼男爵城堡里藏有多少稀有珍宝，再到达维奥特找一对父子档旧货商挖掘只有北部才找得到的稀奇好物。

programme.title: 旧货猎人-最赞买卖第4季:第4集
programme.desc: 在本集的节目中，德鲁普里察带著观众一同欣赏他在市集和拍卖会上所购买到的各式各样有趣、特别、罕见的物品，并传授各位观众一个重要准则，那就是「早起的鸟儿有虫吃」。

programme.title: 凯文哈特的肌肉车俱乐部第1季:第2集
programme.desc: 凯文找了一个仓库，想改造成俱乐部会所，但是里面堆满杂物，大家不愿意清理。之前在车聚里认识的连恩邀请他们去欧文代尔赛道参观和体验短道直线竞速。只有约翰和史班克愿意上场，约翰以0.2秒险胜史班克，自诩是全队最强。迷上直线竞速的约翰找拉奇让车子速度更快，拉奇建议他加装机械增压器。哈利拗不过女儿赛吉要求开他的车，请拉奇想办法让车子满足父女各自的驾驶需求。拉奇找来调校师汤姆，将哈利的调校成可切换的两种模式。凯文整理好俱乐部会所，第一次开会要决定每个人负责的工作。哈利负责标志设计、伯斯负责行销和社群媒体、史班克负责活动规画、乔伊负责装饰布置、约翰负责清理和倒垃圾。

programme.title: 用鱼叉猎黑鲔第1季:第9集
programme.desc: 渔季进入最后两天，竞争越发激烈，成绩较好的船长希望取得领先，成绩较差的船长也希望把握最后机会。

programme.title: 翻新中古车-世界巡回第2季:第4集
programme.desc: 墨西哥越野金龟 在全英国翻新了上百辆令人惊艳的中古车后，迈克布鲁尔和马克艾维斯普力斯利迎接新的挑战。他们即将展开环球巡回冒险，入手、修复、卖出世界上最经典的车子，像是法拉利348、澳洲Holden冲浪车。在这趟史诗级公路之旅中，迈克和艾维斯沉浸在各个国家的汽车文化中，结识不可思议的人物、参与精彩的活动并探寻当地的专业。最重要的是，他们使用翻新中古车的老经验来拯救每台车，打造可以卖出好价钱的好车

programme.title: 渔人的搏斗维京篇第1季:第6集
programme.desc: 由于挪威巨蟹迟迟未现身，席格决定改捕红帝王蟹补齐订单，以免无法顺利交货。杰克请太太将爸爸的骨灰寄来船上，打算带著爸爸的骨灰一起出海捕蟹。

programme.title: 旧货猎人第10季:第11集
programme.desc: 本集节目中德鲁走访萨弗克拥有百年历史的皇家御用丝绸制造商，前往苏格兰高地一探克吕尼男爵城堡里藏有多少稀有珍宝，再到达维奥特找一对父子档旧货商挖掘只有北部才找得到的稀奇好物。

programme.title: 翻新中古车第12季:第2集
programme.desc: 这次麦克要找一款最能代表美式粗犷美感的1950年代经典皮卡福特F1。车身涂料虽已全部磨光，麦克却能看出它的潜力，买下后交由艾德著手重建。

programme.title: 凯文哈特的肌肉车俱乐部第1季:第3集
programme.desc: 凯文哈特带俱乐部成员来到亚利桑那州的雷德福赛车学校学习过弯、打滑控制、加减速与车辆重心转移等驾驶技巧。俱乐部会所的整顿即将完成，拉奇帮约翰的卡迈罗换上机械增压器，史班克也去找拉奇，讨论出更换LS引擎和升级悬吊的改装方案。

programme.title: 用鱼叉猎黑鲔第1季:第9集
programme.desc: 渔季进入最后两天，竞争越发激烈，成绩较好的船长希望取得领先，成绩较差的船长也希望把握最后机会。

programme.title: 旧货猎人-最赞买卖第4季:第4集
programme.desc: 在本集的节目中，德鲁普里察带著观众一同欣赏他在市集和拍卖会上所购买到的各式各样有趣、特别、罕见的物品，并传授各位观众一个重要准则，那就是「早起的鸟儿有虫吃」。

programme.title: 抢救脱网族第7季:第13集
programme.desc: 脱网族生活疯狂流行起来，许多家庭举家搬到更鸟不生蛋的地方，而且还信心满满。但对于追求自给自足的脱网新手来说，极端计划通常只会导致极端问题。

programme.title: 渔人的搏斗维京篇第1季:第7集
programme.desc: 席格找到愿意合作的蟹获经销商，前提是他们每周必须捕到23公吨的帝王蟹。为了达成目标，他们兵分三路以增加长期战力。他们能顺利捕足帝王蟹，稳固合作关系吗？

programme.title: 绝地伐木勇士第2季:第3集
programme.desc: 自古以来，伐木一直是人类生活的重要产业，时至今日，仍是世界上最危险的工作之一。树越大，风险越高...报酬也越可观。在太平洋西北地区，伐木工杰瑞德道格拉斯带著团队，采伐世界上最巨大、最有价值的树种之一：北美桧木。但要把这些体积跟巴士一样大的巨木，从森林运送到市场一点也不容易。不仅需要高超的锯木功夫、规模庞大的机械设备，还要有在地表最严酷环境上工的勇气。

programme.title: 艾德史塔福-男子汉的洗礼第1季:第2集
programme.desc: 艾德史塔福寻找并参与世界上最艰苦、最危险、最严苛的部落成年礼，探索这些古老习俗是否可能是社会和个人危机的解答。世界上有许多地方透过身体和精神的仪式，引导凝聚族群的人们。

programme.title: 凯文哈特的肌肉车俱乐部第1季:第4集
programme.desc: 哈利开了新买的手排66年新星双门小跑车到俱乐部会所，与约翰及凯文三人比试路边停车技术。他设计了三款俱乐部标志，全部受到众人鄙弃。哈利与约翰都想将车子改成趴地风，史班克正在找涂装灵感，于是三人到彼得森汽车博物馆取经，顺便见识大名鼎鼎的趴地风始祖吉普赛玫瑰。史班克想把看到的各种经典特色都用在自己的雪维尔上。拉奇替史班克的雪维尔更换成有525匹马力的引擎，凯文带著伯斯和乔伊拜访卡通先生的汽车俱乐部，向前辈吸取创立和经营汽车俱乐部的经验。三人在参观过程中不断意见不合，也发现自己的俱乐部还欠缺很多东西。凯文俱乐部的所有成员乘坐卡通先生俱乐部的车上街兜风。

programme.desc: 马德里机场的海关人员在扫描行李时发现旅客拿错行李，协助旅客找回属于她的行李。

programme.title: 西班牙边境护卫队第7季:第8集
programme.desc: 利尼亚边境管制局逮到一名旅客携带长达三个月用量的药物，却没有处方笺。

programme.title: 仓储挖宝王第2季:第17集
programme.desc: 艾伦和汤到好莱坞竞标仓库，其中一间仓库里面有1870年代的指虎小刀枪，以及专用的子弹数枚，连卖枪50年的专家，都是第一次见到这个古董。

programme.title: 仓储挖宝王第2季:第18集
programme.desc: 安纳海母相当于橘郡的比佛利山庄，因为这里有许多有钱人家。艾伦和汤到这里买到两间仓库，在里面发现了一批古董诱兽鸭。

programme.title: 渔人的搏斗维京篇第1季:第8集
programme.desc: 席格团队分头行动，席格跟杰克驾驶史托巴斯号前往遥远的北方，克拉克驾驶柏格松号待在峡湾内的近海，曼蒂则为克拉克提供情报支援。

programme.title: 波兰边境护卫队第1季:第6集
programme.desc: 在本集节目中，海关人员发现一对父子档似乎在进行走私活动，而有只狗狗在跨越边境时引起了顾虑，牠能否顺利进入波兰呢？另外，一位曾经被没收车辆的走私惯犯再次出现，而他是否已改过自新了？

programme.title: 旧货猎人第10季:第13集
programme.desc: 德鲁到乡村生活博物馆、美术工艺博物馆、古董商罗伯巴利家寻宝。

programme.title: 旧货猎人第15季:第2集
programme.desc: 为了增添店面里的销售物品，德鲁普里察及堤伊驱车造访集结各家古董商、销售许多引人入胜物件的葛来芬磨坊古董店商场；此外更前往一座可能藏有高价值古董文物的酿酒厂；更来到由德鲁心目中的偶像所设计出的古代典雅庄园。

programme.title: 艾德史塔福-男子汉的洗礼第1季:第3集
programme.desc: 艾德史塔福寻找并参与世界上最艰苦、最危险、最严苛的部落成年礼，探索这些古老习俗是否可能是社会和个人危机的解答。世界上有许多地方透过身体和精神的仪式，引导凝聚族群的人们。

programme.title: 原始生活21天西班牙版第1季:第1集
programme.desc: 五对陌生伙伴必须赤裸裸在丛林中生存21天，这场极端环境的求生挑战，考验著所有人的极限...

programme.title: 翻新中古车-世界巡回第2季:第4集
programme.desc: 墨西哥越野金龟 在全英国翻新了上百辆令人惊艳的中古车后，迈克布鲁尔和马克艾维斯普力斯利迎接新的挑战。他们即将展开环球巡回冒险，入手、修复、卖出世界上最经典的车子，像是法拉利348、澳洲Holden冲浪车。在这趟史诗级公路之旅中，迈克和艾维斯沉浸在各个国家的汽车文化中，结识不可思议的人物、参与精彩的活动并探寻当地的专业。最重要的是，他们使用翻新中古车的老经验来拯救每台车，打造可以卖出好价钱的好车

programme.title: 脚病诊所第1季:第6集
programme.desc: 超爱买鞋的伊莲天生就有并趾，从小饱受霸凌，也对自己的畸形脚趾感到非常自卑，无法如愿穿漂亮的鞋子。凯丝琳的右脚奇痒无比，甚至要在床边放一把梳子抓痒。

programme.title: 你、我和我的前任第2季:第4集
programme.desc: 卡洛琳与亚利克将意外怀孕的消息告诉亚利克的前任史帝夫，虽然婚礼不得不延期，但史帝夫仍决定要帮亚利克办一场荣升父亲派对。卡洛琳与自己的母亲丽莎和解，母女俩关系改善，丽莎也主动表示愿意帮忙带孙。麦特在肯西面前称赞前女友雀儿喜的大胸部，令肯西十分不是滋味，甚至连雀儿喜都觉得麦特欺人太甚。德安德烈带女友埃洛荻第一次见母亲维吉，却也叫前女友萝雯出席。萝雯不仅与德安德烈仍暧昧不清，还是维吉的好闺密，使埃洛荻倍感威胁。

programme.title: 按部就班换好屋第1季:第8集
programme.desc: 海瑟和朱利安准备好卖掉排水问题严重的旧房子，换一间格局更好，机能性更佳的新家，跟女儿一起打造美好的回忆。

programme.title: 问题皮肤救星第3季:第11集
programme.desc: 蜜雪儿的脸经常因疾病发作而肿胀，几乎看不出原本的脸型，然而看过的医生都找不出真正病因来治疗，让她自信渐失，也不再出门；盖瑞斯的侧身上有颗肿块，不但疼痛还连带影响工作状况，造成他自信尽失，连面对枕边人都不想谈论；李的头上有个肿块，他感到没自信而不再和家人出门，造成家人感情快失和，甚至想拿把刀自己切掉肿块；艾莉的脸部发红脱屑严重，经多位医生诊断后却毫无改善、甚至更恶化，走投无路的她连出门都感到尴尬。

programme.title: 到国外征婚去第1季:第5集
programme.desc: 马克的第一个对象苏凯娜很符合他的条件，但20岁的年龄差距却令他相当介意。苏珊喜欢第二个对象卡洛斯的率真，但他的心智对她而言又太年轻了。

programme.title: 低价丑屋变好宅第1季:第5集
programme.desc: 克莉丝蒂李Cristy Lee协助心灰意冷的购屋族，找出价格令人惊喜的的潜力物件，缺点就是屋况通常满恐怖的。但只要他们愿意相信克莉丝蒂刻划的愿景，她就能把最糟糕的房子改造成他们梦想中的家。

programme.title: 你、我和我的前任第2季:第4集
programme.desc: 卡洛琳与亚利克将意外怀孕的消息告诉亚利克的前任史帝夫，虽然婚礼不得不延期，但史帝夫仍决定要帮亚利克办一场荣升父亲派对。卡洛琳与自己的母亲丽莎和解，母女俩关系改善，丽莎也主动表示愿意帮忙带孙。麦特在肯西面前称赞前女友雀儿喜的大胸部，令肯西十分不是滋味，甚至连雀儿喜都觉得麦特欺人太甚。德安德烈带女友埃洛荻第一次见母亲维吉，却也叫前女友萝雯出席。萝雯不仅与德安德烈仍暧昧不清，还是维吉的好闺密，使埃洛荻倍感威胁。

programme.title: 按部就班换好屋第1季:第8集
programme.desc: 海瑟和朱利安准备好卖掉排水问题严重的旧房子，换一间格局更好，机能性更佳的新家，跟女儿一起打造美好的回忆。

programme.title: 到美国结婚去婚后篇第9季:第22集
programme.desc: 经历繁琐漫长的签证流程，现在正式结婚成为夫妻!但很快就发现蜜月期一瞬间就结束，现实生活的挑战接踵而来。

programme.title: 我是尚娜雷第2季:第1集
programme.desc: 本集节目中，尚娜与新的配对对象第一次约会，对方是同样患有垂体性侏儒症的汤玛斯。

programme.title: 六千金在我家第5季:第7集
programme.desc: 因为戴尔确诊，大家都需要去做筛检，紧张地在家等结果。结果出来后都是阴性，于是暂停的露营车之旅死灰复燃，厨房和楼梯的工程也可以继续下去。

programme.title: 你、我和我的前任第2季:第5集
programme.desc: 亚利克即将去参加史帝夫筹办的人父派对，卡洛琳警告他们不准请脱衣舞娘。麦特带雀儿喜去喝酒，被丢在家的肯西气得跳脚。珍妮佛一家终于搬到新家，香泰尔仍然对两家子同住的决定感到排斥。德安德烈邀请妈妈跟萝雯来他举办的首饰宣传派对，埃洛荻决定单独找萝雯谈旅行的事。

programme.title: 巴比与吉娅达的义大利之旅第1季:第2集
programme.desc: 主持人去了罗马老电影城区的披萨店「索佛诺」，接著造访知名义式冰淇淋大师玛莉亚的实验厨房。此外两人还到特雷维喷泉许愿，希望能再重返罗马。

programme.title: 阿贤亚洲好食光第1季:第11集

programme.title: 阿贤亚洲好食光第1季:第12集

programme.title: 我的梦幻婚纱第20季:第9集

programme.title: 义式烹饪大赛第1季:第1集

programme.title: 我的梦幻婚纱第20季:第10集

programme.title: 亚洲好住家第8季:第5集

programme.title: 亚洲好住家第8季:第6集

programme.title: 超级大体型第2季:第3集
